items.title: White won't boot Fiji's flair into touch on World Cup quest, says chairman
items.author: Ian Ransom
items.creator: Ian Ransom
items.summary: Jake White and Fijian flair might seem an unlikely formula for World Cup success but the nation's rugby boss is confident the pragmatic South African coach will embrace their free-wheeling spirit and help them reach the semi-finals for the first time.
items.body:
Jake White and Fijian flair might seem an unlikely formula for World Cup success but the nation's rugby boss is confident the pragmatic South African coach will embrace their free-wheeling spirit and help them reach the semi-finals for the first time.
Unveiled as Fiji's coach last week, White will take the reins for the first time in Tokyo on Saturday against Japan, seeking to restore the team's confidence a month after their defeat to Eddie Jones' side in the Pacific Nations Cup final.
White's task is to turn Fiji into a serious World Cup contender in Australia next year, 20 years on from guiding South Africa to their second World Cup title in France.
How a coach renowned for structure, discipline and territorial kicking will gel with Fiji's ethos of running rugby remains to be seen.
But Fiji Rugby Union (FRU) Chairman John Sanday said 62-year-old White's open-mindedness had impressed him during the hiring process.
"We always want to maintain what we're good at and just fix what we're not good at," Sanday told Reuters on Wednesday.
"Jake came across very clearly. He spelt out in quite some detail what he thinks should be done and where.
"He has identified where the gaps and weaknesses are and what the prescription is to fix them."
Three years ago, the "Flying Fijians" shocked Australia on the way to the quarter-finals in France and might have reached a first semi-final but for the boot of England's Owen Farrell.
The FRU have set the bar higher for next year's tournament, where 10th-ranked Fiji will play Argentina, Canada and Spain in Pool C.
White has his work cut out. After parting ways with Mick Byrne in April, Fiji lost all three Nations Championship tests in July under interim boss Senirusi Seruvakula, including a 73-8 humiliation by England in Liverpool.
KICKING THE BALL AWAY Tactical kicking has become an increasingly potent attacking weapon in international rugby, but Sanday said Fiji had lost their way by trying to bring it into their game - and he had discussed that with White.
"We were starting to head in that direction. The players were putting up box kicks and kicking the ball away to the opposition," said Sanday, a former Fiji lock who played in the inaugural 1987 World Cup.
"There's nothing more fearful than a Fijian player running with the ball. Why are we kicking the ball away? It just doesn't make sense.
"I said, 'Look Jake, our strength is ball in hand. The high ball may work with other teams, but I would prefer if we tried to find better ideas and better systems to enable us to express our running game much more clearly, because that's the strength of the Flying Fijians.'"
White said at his first press conference as coach last week that he wanted Fiji to play their natural game but with a bit more structure and attention to game management overall.
He will move to Fiji in January and spend at least six months there working closely with the nation's sole professional team, Fijian Drua, and scouring local competitions for talent.
Sanday said White would be afforded space and time to rebuild the team. He was confident White would have no problem fitting into the Pacific island's culture and that the players and wider Fijian rugby community would embrace him.
"His charisma and presence will rub off on our local coaches and players in the districts and unions," he said.
"I think it's a Fijian thing culturally that we look up to people who have proven themselves and achieved great things."
items.raw_description: Jake White and Fijian flair might seem an unlikely formula for World Cup success but the nation's rugby boss is confident the pragmatic South African coach will embrace their free-wheeling spirit and help them reach the semi-finals for the first time.

items.title: 中国、台湾実効支配の東沙諸島周辺で「秩序維持」と主張
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [北京 ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[北京 ２１日 ロイター] - 中国政府は２１日、台湾が実効支配する東沙（プラタス）諸島の周辺で、中国海警局が「秩序を維持している」と述べた。南シナ海北端にある東沙諸島は戦略的な要衝に位置し、台湾側は中国が管轄権の行使を図っていると警戒している。

台湾を自国領と見なす中国は先週、台湾の海巡署（沿岸警備隊）が東沙諸島付近で中国漁船に放水砲を使用したことを巡り、台湾側は『その結果を引き受けなければならない』と警告した。

台湾は１８日以降、中国海警局の船舶が東沙諸島に接近した事例を２件確認したと発表し、中国側の行動を挑発的だと非難している。

中国国務院台湾事務弁公室の張晗報道官は定例記者会見で、中国は東沙諸島を含む南シナ海の島々とその周辺海域に対し「争う余地のない主権」を有すると述べた。

張氏は「関係海域で法執行のための巡視を行う中国海警局の船舶は、法に従って職務を遂行し、正常な航行や操業の秩序を維持している」と説明し、海警局の船は「台湾海峡両岸の人々の合法的かつ正当な権益と、生命・財産の安全を効果的に守っている」と述べた。

また、台湾の与党が分離独立の立場に「固執している」ことが、台湾海峡で戦争の危険が生じる根本原因だと主張した。

一方、台湾で対中国政策を担う大陸委員会の邱垂正主任委員は２０日夜、台北で開かれたフォーラムで、中国は台湾問題を「国内問題化」し、「台湾周辺の海域や離島に対し、事実上の管轄権を持つかのような印象をつくり出そうとしている」と述べた。

邱氏は、習近平国家主席の４期目入りが２０２７年に決まると見込まれる中、中国にとって「国家統一の実現」という使命の切迫性が一段と増していると指摘した。

「中国の対台湾政策は、『統一を実現する前に管轄権を行使する』という、より攻撃的で挑発的な戦略に移行するとわれわれは分析している」と述べた。

items.title: India's Bajaj Finance falls on regulatory concerns, inflation risk
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Shares of India's Bajaj Finance fell as much as 2.9% on Wednesday, as regulatory overhangs and concerns surrounding future income growth overshadowed a strong second-quarter performance.
items.body:
Shares of India's Bajaj Finance (BJFN.NS) fell as much as 2.9% on Wednesday, as regulatory overhangs and concerns surrounding future income growth overshadowed a strong second-quarter performance.
Shares were trading 2.1% lower at 937.2 rupees as of 10:16 a.m. IST, while the benchmark Nifty 50 (.NSEI) index was up 0.3%.
The non-banking financial company [USN:L4N4650WZ TEXT:"reported"] a nearly 30% year-on-year rise in consolidated profit after tax on Monday. Indian financial markets were shut for a public holiday on Tuesday.
Brokerages, however, flagged risk from rising inflation in the country, with the central bank indicating a tighter monetary policy path.
A rising interest-rate environment was likely to create marginal headwinds for net interest margins, said Nomura, while also flagging a sequential weakening in asset quality.
Nomura trimmed its earnings-per-share estimates for fiscals 2028 and 2029 by 2%-3%.
Jefferies flagged potential regulatory restrictions on flexi-loans, which could affect about 5% of assets under management, and proposed changes to insurance distribution fees, which account for about 8% of the NBFC's fiscal 2026 profit before tax.
The brokerage cut its target price to 1,230 rupees from 1,280 rupees.
PhillipCapital echoed those concerns, citing three regulatory overhangs: draft Reserve Bank of India rules on revolving loans, possible changes to insurance commissions and revised gold-loan rules.
The brokerage said an outright ban on revolving loans could temporarily hurt AUM growth and slightly compress margins and profitability.
Bajaj Finance's shares are rated "buy" on average by 34 analysts with median PT at 1,195 rupees, as per data compiled by LSEG.
The stock has fallen nearly 5% so far this year.

items.title: Netflix-Wachstum schwächt sich weiter ab - Verhaltener Ausblick
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Getragen vom Erfolg der zweiten Staffel von "The Gentlemen" und der Neuauflage von "Unsere kleine Farm" hat Netflix einen überraschend hohen Quartalsgewinn verbucht. Der weltgrößte Streamingdienst gab am Dienstag jedoch einen verhaltenen Ausblick, nachdem das Umsatzwachstum auf den niedrigsten Stand seit knapp drei Jahren gesunken war. Darüber hinaus belasteten die Kosten für den Stellenabbau die Bilanz. Die Netflix-Aktie brach daraufhin im nachbörslichen Handel an der Wall Street um knapp fünf Prozent ein.
items.body:
Getragen vom Erfolg der zweiten Staffel von "The Gentlemen" und der Neuauflage von "Unsere kleine Farm" hat Netflix (NFLX.O) einen überraschend hohen Quartalsgewinn verbucht. Der weltgrößte Streamingdienst gab am Dienstag jedoch einen verhaltenen Ausblick, nachdem das Umsatzwachstum auf den niedrigsten Stand seit knapp drei Jahren gesunken war. Darüber hinaus belasteten die Kosten für den Stellenabbau die Bilanz. Die Netflix-Aktie brach daraufhin im nachbörslichen Handel an der Wall Street um knapp fünf Prozent ein.
Die Erlöse stiegen in den vergangenen drei Monaten um knapp zwölf Prozent auf 12,87 Milliarden Dollar. Im Vorjahreszeitraum hatten sie um 17,2 Prozent zugelegt. Eine Beschleunigung des Wachstums ist vorerst nicht in Sicht. Der US-Konzern erwartet für das Schlussquartal 2026 ein Plus von zwölf Prozent auf 13,4 Milliarden Dollar. Der Reingewinn sprang zwar um knapp 30 Prozent auf 0,87 Dollar je Aktie, der Hauptgrund hierfür waren jedoch verschobene Ausgaben. Im vierten Quartal dürfte das Nettoergebnis bei 0,67 Dollar je Aktie liegen. Analysten hatten mit 0,73 Dollar je Aktie gerechnet.
Netflix kämpft mit verschärftem Wettbewerb. Das Unternehmen wachse nicht so schnell, wie er es sich wünsche, hatte Co-Chef Ted Sarandos unlängst betont. Vor allem YouTube baut nach Angaben der Marktforschungsfirma Nielsen seinen Marktanteil aus. Die Nutzungszeit falle fast doppelt so hoch aus wie bei Netflix. Gleichzeitig wanderten fast dreimal so viele Abonnenten ab wie in den vorangegangenen Quartalen. Daher will das Unternehmen etwa 1000 Stellen streichen. Das entspricht etwa sechs Prozent der Belegschaft.
Netflix bekräftigte zwar sein Ziel eines Konzernumsatzes im Gesamtjahr von 51,18 Milliarden Dollar. Die Prognose für die Werbeeinnahmen schraubte der Streamingdienst dagegen auf rund 2,7 Milliarden von etwa drei Milliarden Dollar zurück. Ein überraschend hohes Wachstum der klassischen Abonnements gleiche dies jedoch aus.
Netflix setzt seit einigen Jahren verstärkt auf werbefinanzierte Nutzerkonten. Diese versprechen langfristig höhere Erträge. Dazu müssen Zuschauer jedoch möglichst lange an den Bildschirm gefesselt werden. Hierzu sollen unter anderem Live-Übertragungen von Konzerten oder Sportereignissen beitragen. Darüber hinaus schloss das Unternehmen Lizenzvereinbarungen mit dem Konkurrenten Walt Disney (DIS.N) , um beispielsweise die Animationsfilme der "Ice Age"-Reihe zeigen zu können.

TOKYO, Oct 21 : Japan's underlying inflation is quite close to the central bank's 2 per cent target and financial conditions remain loose, Deputy Bank of Japan Governor Ryozo Himino said on Wednesday, signalling readiness to raise borrowing costs.
While rising fuel and raw material costs are pushing up prices, brisk global AI demand is also putting upward pressure on prices by boosting exports and capital expenditure, Himino told parliament.
"Given medium- and long-term inflation expectations continue to heighten, underlying inflation is quite close to 2 per cent and will likely converge to levels consistent with our price target," Himino said.
"Even after last month's rate hike, financial conditions remain accommodative" as seen in still-low real borrowing costs and strong growth in bank lending, he said.
"Given that inflation risks are high, delaying necessary adjustment to monetary support could materialise such risks and hurt the economy in the long run," Himino said, calling for the need to continue raising interest rates.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Dubai's largest bank Emirates ENBD posts flat third-quarter profit
items.author: Federico Maccioni
items.creator: Federico Maccioni
items.summary: Emirates NBD , Dubai's largest bank by assets, posted a flat third-quarter profit on Wednesday.
items.body:
Emirates NBD (ENBD.DU) , Dubai's largest bank by assets, posted a flat third-quarter profit on Wednesday.
Quarterly profit was 6.4 billion dirhams ($1.74 billion), ENBD said in a statement
Net profit in the first nine months grew 2% year-on-year to 19.3 billion dirhams, as net interest income boosted income.
The Middle East conflict brought turmoil to the region this year, impacting energy flows, logistics and tourism
While business in the Gulf's business and tourism hub, Dubai, has largely resumed, recovery in sectors such as hospitality could take longer
"Activity in sectors like tourism, trade and logistics remains moderate," ENBD said, noting that the UAE economy continues to expand despite "ongoing regional tensions"
However, the International Monetary Fund has forecast a dire 2026 for the Gulf region and expects the UAE economy to contract 3.9% before rebounding in 2027
Emirates NBD said income was up 15% at 42.2 billion dirhams in the first nine months, while expenses rose 19% to 13.3 billion dirhams
Gross loans grew 27% to 833 billion dirhams at the end of the first nine months. They were up 18%, excluding RBL (RATB.NS) , the Indian bank whose acquisition ENBD completed this year
Deposits grew 19% year-to-date to 935 billion dirhams, ENBD said, citing "a growing customer base". They were up 12%, excluding RBL
Emirates NBD, majority-owned by Dubai's government, said total assets rose to 1.38 trillion dirhams at the end of the first nine months of the year
($1 = 3.6725 UAE dirham)

items.title: SpaceX verdoppelt Umsatz - KI-Ausgaben verdreifacht
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Dank eines boomenden KI- und Satellitengeschäfts hat SpaceX seinen Quartalsumsatz mehr als verdoppelt. Die Ausgaben für neue Rechenzentren hätten sich in den vergangenen Monaten jedoch nahezu verdreifacht, teilte der Raumfahrtkonzern des Milliardärs Elon Musk am Dienstag mit. "Wir stehen vor einem Wendepunkt in den Bereichen Raketenstarts, Vernetzung und KI", sagte Musk bei einer Telefonkonferenz mit Investoren.
items.body:
Dank eines boomenden KI- und Satellitengeschäfts hat SpaceX (SPCX.O) seinen Quartalsumsatz mehr als verdoppelt. Die Ausgaben für neue Rechenzentren hätten sich in den vergangenen Monaten jedoch nahezu verdreifacht, teilte der Raumfahrtkonzern des Milliardärs Elon Musk am Dienstag mit. "Wir stehen vor einem Wendepunkt in den Bereichen Raketenstarts, Vernetzung und KI", sagte Musk bei einer Telefonkonferenz mit Investoren.
Das US-Unternehmen steigerte die Erlöse den Angaben zufolge überraschend deutlich um 161 Prozent auf 14,6 Milliarden Dollar. Das stärkste Wachstum verzeichnete dabei die Sparte KI mit einem Plus von 830 Prozent. Sie erwirtschaftete 7,56 Milliarden Dollar und löste die Satellitentochter Starlink als wichtigsten Umsatzbringer ab. Dieser Geschäftsbereich verdient sein Geld hauptsächlich mit der Vermietung von Rechenkapazitäten für KI-Entwickler wie Anthropic oder Reflection AI. In den vergangenen drei Monaten steckte SpaceX 16,4 Milliarden Dollar in den Ausbau seiner KI-Infrastruktur. Dies war der Löwenanteil der konzernweiten Investitionen von 19,6 Milliarden Dollar.
SCHLAGZEILENTRÄCHTIGER GEWINNBRINGER Starlink wuchs im Berichtszeitraum um knapp 70 Prozent und erwirtschaftete fast den kompletten operativen Konzerngewinn von 2,79 Milliarden Dollar. Die Zahl der Nutzer stieg zwar überraschend deutlich auf 13,6 Millionen, der durchschnittliche Monatsumsatz pro Nutzer ging jedoch wegen günstiger Einsteigertarife in neu erschlossenen Märkten [USN:L8N4413FO TEXT:"erneut"] zurück.
Unabhängig davon sorgt der Satellitenbetreiber immer wieder für Aufsehen: Die Ukraine wirft dem US-Konzern vor, die Geschwindigkeit der Datenübertragung zu drosseln und damit die [USN:L8N4601IH TEXT:"Verteidigung des Landes"] zu behindern. Die Starlink-Satelliten dienen der Kommunikation auf dem Gefechtsfeld sowie der Steuerung von Drohnenangriffen und der Flugabwehr.
Darüber hinaus drängt Starlink verstärkt in den Mobilfunkmarkt und hat sich in den USA bereits [USN:L6N45V0CR TEXT:"umfangreiche Funkfrequenzen"] gesichert. Das Unternehmen will satellitengestützte Gespräche und Datenübertragungen über handelsübliche Smartphones anbieten. Für die "Direct-to-Device"-Technologie ist es bislang meist auf Kooperationen mit klassischen Mobilfunkanbietern wie der [USN:L8N3ZQ1OR TEXT:"Deutschen Telekom"] (DTEGn.DE) und deren US-Tochter T-Mobile (TMUS.O) angewiesen.
Um dieser drohenden Konkurrenz zu begegnen, haben die Telekom, Telefonica (TEF.MC) , Vodafone (VOD.L) und Orange (ORAN.PA) eine [USN:L6N4650NC TEXT:"Partnerschaft"] vereinbart. Sie wollen sich gemeinsam um die anstehende Neuvergabe von Satelliten-Funkfrequenzen in Europa bewerben. Die Europäische Union (EU) hat zwei Drittel des Spektrums für heimische Anbieter [USN:L8N42311G TEXT:"reserviert"]. Die US-Regierung habe einem Zeitungsbericht zufolge verärgert auf diese Pläne reagiert. Sollte die EU den Marktzugang für US-Unternehmen einschränken, drohten "[USN:L8N46408J TEXT:"verheerende"]" Vergeltungsmaßnahmen, schrieb die "Financial Times".

items.title: Samsung, SK Hynix upgrading China plants to make more advanced chips, people say
items.author: Hyunjoo Jin, Liam Mo, Karen Freifeld
items.creator: Hyunjoo Jin, Liam Mo, Karen Freifeld
items.summary: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are upgrading their China factories to produce more advanced memory chips, four people familiar with the plans said, aiming to fend off competition from a fast-growing Chinese rival and meet huge AI demand.
items.body:
Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) and SK Hynix (000660.KS) are upgrading their China factories to produce more advanced memory chips, four people familiar with the plans said, aiming to fend off competition from a fast-growing Chinese rival and meet huge AI demand.
How much to invest in their Chinese operations has become a tricky question for the South Korean semiconductor giants ever since the US began imposing export controls on some chip-making equipment in 2022 amid an effort to slow China's technological progress.
Both companies are now required to seek US licenses annually if they want to install US-made equipment such as etching machines in China. The US Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security also said in 2025 it did not intend to grant licenses to upgrade technology and expand capacity at the foreign chipmakers' factories in China.
The regulatory headaches have limited their ability to refit their factories and contributed to loss of market share to Yangtze Memory Technologies Co (YMTC). Executives at the South Korean chipmakers have publicly warned that geopolitical tensions are undermining their Chinese operations.
Samsung and SK Hynix confirmed in statements to Reuters that upgrades were underway and were being done in close consultation with Washington, but did not disclose details of production plans that are being reported here for the first time.
Reuters could not, however, determine to what extent US authorities have granted export licences for equipment that Samsung and SK Hynix need for their planned upgrades.
According to the people, the two companies are working to manufacture flash NAND memory chips with more than 200 layers at their Chinese plants, which would bring them in line with what is being produced in South Korea.
NAND, a type of memory chip that retains data without power, is widely used in smartphones, PCs and solid-state drives for AI data centres. More layers per chip means more storage density and lower costs.
SAMSUNG SETS SIGHTS ON 286-LAYER CHIPS Samsung's plant in Xian in northwestern China, which accounts for about 40% of the company's global NAND output, currently makes chips that have about 200 layers, according to two of the people.
As part of a project known internally as "Monami" — from the French for "my friend" — Samsung is converting the facility to make 286-layer V9 NAND chips, aiming for monthly output of 5,000 wafers in December this year and then a jump to 40,000 wafers by December 2027, one of the people said.
Samsung said its upgrade was in compliance with US export regulations, adding: "The upgrade is aimed at meeting growing demand from global customers, including those in the US. The company is not expanding production capacity or constructing new manufacturing facilities."
SK Hynix is looking to switch to producing NAND products with 240 layers or more at its Dalian facilities in northeastern China, three people familiar with the matter said.
It currently makes products with 192 layers there, one person said.
SK Hynix acquired the Dalian site when it bought Intel's NAND operations in 2021 and it remains the sole NAND chip manufacturing site for that business, which is now named Solidigm and is preparing for [USN:L1N45I00G TEXT:"a US initial public offering"].
One of the people said the company is authorised to make chips with up to 240 layers at Dalian and may seek permission from Washington to conduct research and development on 300-plus-layer chips there that would help it lay the groundwork for potential production in the US. The company is in [USN:L1N46102A TEXT:"discussions"] with the Trump administration over plans to build [USN:L1N45A06G TEXT:"a new NAND factory in the United States."]
The US government's Bureau of Industry and Security did not directly address Reuters questions on the status of approvals for the South Korean chipmakers. It referred Reuters to its 2025 statement that the bureau intended to grant license applications for them to operate their existing factories in China, but not expand capacity or upgrade technology.
YMTC MAKES PROGRESS As Samsung and SK Hynix have wrestled with the question of how much to invest in their Chinese plants, YMTC has made great strides.
It commanded 38.5% of China's NAND market in the second quarter, up from 28% for all of 2025 and overtaking Samsung, according to research firm Omdia. In contrast, Samsung's share has slipped to 33.5% from 36% while SK Hynix's share has dropped to 17% from 20%.
YMTC's product lineup is mostly 160- and 232-layer NAND chips, but it also produces a small amount of 294-layer chips and plans to manufacture products with more than 300 layers, according to two separate people.
YMTC did not respond to a Reuters request for comment.
Outside China, Samsung sells NAND chips with up to 286 layers and it also unveiled a [USN:L4N4410QX TEXT:"prototype NAND chip"] with more than 400 layers in August. SK Hynix sells NAND chips that are up to 321 layers.
items.raw_description: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are upgrading their China factories to produce more advanced memory chips, four people familiar with the plans said, aiming to fend off competition from a fast-growing Chinese rival and meet huge AI demand.

items.title: Minera canadiense obtiene licencia de EE.UU. para enviar combustible a Cuba y rescatar su mina de níquel
items.author: Paula Sambo
items.summary: La autorización permite entregar combustible, fueloil y azufre a las operaciones de níquel en Moa, pero la empresa aún necesita otros permisos para reanudar la producción y busca capital para superar ...
items.body: BLoomberg — Sherritt International Corp. dijo que recibió una inusual licencia del gobierno de Estados Unidos que le permite enviar combustible y azufre a sus operaciones de níquel en Cuba, un paso crucial para reanudar la producción y asegurar un rescate financiero. La autorización de la Oficina de Control de Activos Extranjeros (OFAC) del Departamento del Tesoro de Estados Unidos permite la compra y entrega de combustible, fueloil y azufre a la operación de níquel Moa de la minera canadiense en Cuba, informó la compañía el martes en un comunicado. Es la primera de una serie de licencias de emergencia solicitadas por Sherritt y la firma de inversión estadounidense Gillon Capital LLC para reanudar la extracción y el procesamiento en la isla y volver a refinar en Canadá. Ver más: Exportaciones solares de EE.UU. a Cuba se disparan 1.070% en plena crisis eléctrica de la isla “Es extremadamente inusual en términos de la política de EE.UU. hacia Cuba”, dijo en una entrevista Peter Hancock, CEO de Sherritt. “Esto no nos lleva a la meta, ni mucho menos, pero es una clara indicación de la dirección que estamos tomando”. La aprobación supone un avance significativo para Sherritt, que suspendió en mayo las actividades de sus empresas conjuntas en la isla y detuvo en junio el refinado en sus instalaciones de Fort Saskatchewan, Alberta, después de que el presidente Donald Trump ampliara las sanciones de EE.UU. contra empresas extranjeras que hacen negocios en Cuba. La interrupción ha agravado sus problemas financieros, dejando a la compañía con graves restricciones de liquidez y generando dudas sustanciales sobre su capacidad para continuar operando. Sherritt ha estado trabajando con Gillon Capital, la oficina familiar del magnate inmobiliario y donante del Partido Republicano Ray Washburne, que busca adquirir una participación de control en la compañía. Sherritt inicialmente planeó disolver sus empresas conjuntas cubanas tras la orden ejecutiva de Trump, antes de dar marcha atrás después de que Washburne, exasesor del presidente estadounidense, presentara su propuesta en mayo. “Gillon definitivamente aporta capacidades y conexiones con el gobierno de EE.UU. que Sherritt obviamente no tiene”, dijo Hancock. La licencia de la OFAC también cubre transporte, seguros, servicios bancarios y otros servicios necesarios para entregar los materiales a Cuba, según Sherritt. El Departamento del Tesoro aún no ha publicado la licencia. Ver más: Trump impone nuevas restricciones bancarias al sector privado de Cuba Por separado, Sherritt dijo que alcanzó un acuerdo provisional con Moa Bay Mining Co., titular de una reclamación certificada de EE.UU. relacionada con las operaciones cubanas de níquel en virtud de la Ley Helms-Burton, que permite determinadas demandas por propiedades confiscadas por el gobierno comunista de Cuba. Según el acuerdo del 23 de septiembre, que no había sido anunciado hasta ahora, Moa Bay aceptó permitir los envíos de combustible a cambio de “tarifas de consentimiento” pagadas por Sherritt o en su nombre. También acordó no presentar reclamaciones contra proveedores, bancos, aseguradoras y otras partes involucradas en los envíos autorizados. El acuerdo recibió una autorización separada de la OFAC, según la compañía. El acuerdo provisional aborda uno de los obstáculos legales que enfrentan los posibles compradores de Sherritt. La reclamación, vinculada a Citigroup Inc. ( C ), se remonta a la incautación de los activos mineros por parte del gobierno de Fidel Castro en 1960. Valorada originalmente en US$88 millones por una comisión estadounidense de reclamaciones, es la tercera mayor reclamación certificada contra Cuba. Washburne dijo previamente que estaba dispuesto a comprar la reclamación sobre la mina como parte de su intento por adquirir Sherritt. Un consorcio rival que incluye a Glencore Plc, el multimillonario petrolero de Texas Albert Huddleston y el acreedor de Sherritt Kyma Capital Ltd. también dijo que pretende abordar las reclamaciones dentro del marco legal estadounidense. Otra reclamación, vinculada al negocio de generación eléctrica de Sherritt en Cuba y heredada por el propietario de Office Depot, ha complicado la posición de la compañía. Atlas Holdings LLC, que adquirió la empresa matriz de Office Depot, presentó en julio una demanda por US$803 millones contra la empresa estatal de electricidad de Cuba y Energas SA, una empresa de energía en la que Sherritt posee una participación. Los avances regulatorios podrían fortalecer la posición de Washburne en la batalla por el control de Sherritt, ya que el período de exclusividad de Gillon con la minera canadiense debía expirar este mes. El consorcio rival, que también incluye al cofundador de Brevan Howard, Trifon Natsis, ha propuesto inyectar capital fresco a cambio de al menos 55% de la compañía sobre una base totalmente diluida. Ver más: Cuba recibe US$720 millones en mercancías de EE.UU. pese a la presión de Trump Hancock dijo que el directorio “seguirá considerando seriamente a ese grupo”, así como cualquier otra propuesta que surja. Pero el CEO sugirió que sería difícil para los oferentes rivales replicar el papel de Gillon para conseguir respaldo regulatorio de EE.UU. La licencia para combustible no autoriza a Sherritt a reanudar la producción. La compañía está solicitando otra licencia de emergencia que permitiría reanudar las operaciones de extracción y procesamiento, con el apoyo de Gillon. Se necesitarían aprobaciones adicionales a más largo plazo para permitir que inversionistas estadounidenses adquieran una participación accionaria sustancial en Sherritt y aporten capital para su reestructuración. Sherritt está ultimando los preparativos para un primer envío de combustible, según la compañía. Advirtió que las autorizaciones regulatorias por sí solas no resolverán sus problemas de liquidez ni sus necesidades de capital. La compañía continúa en conversaciones con prestamistas, entidades gubernamentales y otras posibles fuentes de capital estratégico, incluida Gillon. Su capacidad para cumplir sus obligaciones con proveedores y otras partes interesadas depende de conseguir financiamiento adicional e implementar una recapitalización más amplia. Hancock describió las conversaciones con acreedores sénior y de segundo gravamen como frecuentes y productivas, pese a los desacuerdos públicos en torno a los esfuerzos de reestructuración de la compañía. Sherritt no está negociando actualmente posibles quitas de deuda con los acreedores, agregó el CEO. En cambio, las conversaciones se han centrado en cómo los prestamistas pueden apoyar a la compañía en el futuro. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Thunder withstand Spurs' rally in Western Conference finals rematch
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander poured in 32 points as the visiting Oklahoma City Thunder built a huge first-half lead and held on for a 116-104 victory over the San Antonio Spurs on Tuesday in the season opener between last year's top two teams in the Western Conference.
items.body:
Shai Gilgeous-Alexander poured in 32 points as the visiting Oklahoma City Thunder built a huge first-half lead and held on for a 116-104 victory over the San Antonio Spurs on Tuesday in the season opener between last year's top two teams in the Western Conference.
The Thunder swarmed San Antonio in the first half, leading by 21 points at the break after going 10-for-14 from beyond the arc. The Spurs closed to within seven points in both the third and fourth quarters, the latest on Stephon Castle's 3-pointer with 4:18 remaining, but Oklahoma City made the plays down the stretch to secure the win.
Jared McCain added 20 points and matched his career high with six 3-pointers for the Thunder. Chet Holmgren had 14 points and Jalen Williams finished with 12.
Castle led San Antonio with 24 points while Dylan Harper added 18, De'Aaron Fox hit for 14, Victor Wembanyama had 12 points, 13 rebounds and six blocked shots, and Keldon Johnson tallied 10 points. Wembanyama went 1 of 13 from the field, with his only basket on a dunk on a lob to end the third quarter.
Oklahoma City scorched the net from distance in the first quarter, making five of their six 3-point attempts and shooting 59.1% from the field overall to build a 34-28 lead after 12 minutes.
Tensions flared in the second quarter when Fox threw Holmgren to the floor while battling for position in the lane. Wembanyama and Jaylin Williams were among those involved in the ensuing confrontation. Fox received a flagrant-1 foul, and four players were assessed technical fouls. The incident seemed to energize the Thunder, who went on a 9-0 run to extend their lead to 46-30 with 8:09 left in the second quarter.
Oklahoma City extended its lead to as much as 26 points before settling for a 65-44 advantage at the break. Gilgeous-Alexander's 16 points led the Thunder, with McCain adding 11 and Holmgren contributing 10 in the first half.
The Spurs shot just 29.2% from the floor in the first half. Julian Champagnie and Wembanyama each scored eight points to lead San Antonio's tepid attack, with all of Wembanyama's points coming from the free-throw line after he went 0-for-7 from the field before halftime.
San Antonio rallied early in the third quarter, cutting the lead to 74-67 when Castle hit a layup halfway through the period. Oklahoma City responded to San Antonio's surge and carried a 93-80 lead into the fourth quarter.
--Field Level Media

items.title: 仏カルフール、暴動・略奪被害受けて業績予想を下方修正
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Helen Reid　Dominique Vidalon

[ロンドン ２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Helen Reid　Dominique Vidalon

[ロンドン ２０日 ロイター] - フランスの小売業大手カルフールは２０日、国内で発生した暴動と略奪の被害や夜間外出禁止令による影響を踏まえ、年次業績予想を下方修正した。暴動などの影響でコストが増加した上、店舗営業は混乱し、「前例のない状況」に直面していると説明した。

同社は２０２６年の調整後１株利益（ＥＰＳ）について、従来は「１桁台後半の伸び」を見込んでいたが、新たに「横ばいからわずかな増加」となる見通しを示した。また、フリーキャッシュフローは２５年と比べて若干減少すると予想した。

政府の治安対策に対する批判が広がる中、カルフールのアレクサンドル・ボンパール最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は今月２４日に予定されている次回の抗議活動では治安が改善されることを期待しているとしつつも、事業への影響は避けられないとの見方を示した。

ボンパール氏はアナリスト向け電話説明会で「カルフールは直接的かつ大きな打撃を受けた。初日だけで約５０店舗が被害を受け、多くの店舗が略奪され、損害は甚大だ」と言及。さらに、「多くの従業員や取引先が極めてつらい状況に直面した」とし、安全が確保され次第、影響を受けた店舗の営業再開を支援していると説明した。

今回の騒乱は、高騰する燃料価格によって既に弱まっていた消費者心理をさらに悪化させているほか、２６年第４・四半期の重要な年末商戦期が始まる中、カルフール店舗への来店客数を減少させている。

カルフールのマチュー・マリジュ最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は、営業利益への影響が８０００万ユーロ（約９０００万ドル）から２億ユーロに達する可能性があると述べた。

マリジュ氏は記者団に対して「直接的なコストは数千万ユーロに上る。盗難や破壊された商品、損壊した店舗や設備に加え、閉鎖を余儀なくされた店舗もある」と指摘。また、「今後数週間にわたって影響は続く。一部の店舗は夜間外出禁止令のため営業時間を短縮せざるを得ない。さらに広い意味で、われわれは顧客にとって大きな不確実性に特徴づけられる新たな状況に直面していると考えている」と述べた。

マリジュ氏によると、全国約６０００店舗の多くが騒乱を見越して事前に閉鎖された。１８日と１９日も閉鎖されたが、具体的な閉鎖店舗数については明らかにしなかった。

同氏はまた、店舗防衛策として外部の警備員を雇用するなどした結果、コストが増加したと説明。カルフールはパリ、リヨン、マルセイユなどの都市部に小型店を広く展開しているため、小売企業の中でも特に大きな影響を受けたと話した。

items.title: NFLPA calls for investigation into Jalen Hurts' medical situation
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The NFL Players Association, in a statement released Tuesday night, called for a "full investigation" into the situation surrounding the health of Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts.
items.body:
The NFL Players Association, in a statement released Tuesday night, called for a "full investigation" into the situation surrounding the health of Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts.
A superficial blood clot in Hurts' calf was found during an ultrasound on Oct. 10, the day before the Eagles opposed the Jacksonville Jaguars in London. Hurts was cleared to play in that game.
"The NFLPA is not aware of any NFL investigation into the medical care provided to Jalen Hurts," the NFLPA wrote. "In fact, the league previously informed the union that it did not plan to review the care he received.
"Before conclusions are drawn about how this situation was handled, there must be a full investigation into what occurred. Determining the facts is essential to ensuring players receive the highest level of care and protection going forward."
Hurts, 28, is likely out for the rest of the season due to deep vein thrombosis and blood clots in his lungs.
Hurts' current condition, in which the blood clot traveled from his leg to his lungs, was discovered after the Eagles returned to Philadelphia.
Despite widespread speculation and scrutiny over the handling of Hurts' medical situation, with many fans and commentators wondering why Hurts was allowed to play in London, the NFL has backed the Eagles' handling of the quarterback's health.
NFL chief medical officer Allen Sills dismissed concerns during a press conference on Tuesday.
"The notion that there's external factors that any of our physicians would put a player in harm's way -- that's nonsense," Sills said.
--Field Level Media

Russia’s failed Great Game is back in Afghanistan

For Russia, the Afghanistan-Pakistan landscape resembles a chessboard. Chess is a two-player game. But those who practise alone know the trick of playing both sides.

Bantirani Patro

21 October, 2026 10:08 am IST

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

Members of Afghanistan's delegation, led by the Taliban-run government's Acting Labour and Social Affairs Minister Abdul Hanan Omari, attend the St. Petersburg International Economic Forum (SPIEF) in Saint Petersburg, Russia June 5, 2024. REUTERS/Anton Vaganov/File Photo

Follow Us :

Text Size:
A-
A+

-->

L ast week, Russian officials were simultaneously present in Afghanistan, Pakistan and India, suggesting the beginning of another great game along the South Asian frontier, except that Russia no longer has the greatness of its erstwhile empire. Nor does it have a British empire to compete against. But even after decades, the appeal of Afghanistan still remains for Russia.

Russia’s foreign intelligence chief, Sergey Naryshkin , was in Kabul on 14 October to meet the Taliban’s intelligence chief, Abdul Haq Wasiq. The same day, New Delhi hosted the seventh round of the ‘India-Russia Special Mechanism on Pakistan and Afghanistan’. Meanwhile, in Pakistan, Russian interior minister Vladimir Kolokoltsev met the country’s civilian and military leadership, including Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Army Chief Field Marshal Asim Munir. It was the first visit by a Russian interior minister to Pakistan, during which Moscow and Islamabad signed an MoU to strengthen cooperation in combating organised crime.

That three Russian security representatives were in three regional capitals in the same week was unlikely to be a coincidence. Though a full picture of Moscow’s intentions will emerge in the coming months or years, the trajectory is manifest. In this region, Moscow appears to be expanding its role by seeking to mediate between Kabul and Islamabad, all the while coordinating with its time-tested partner New Delhi on the same issue.

Show Full Article

From Soviet invasion to formal recognition
The last Soviet soldier left Afghanistan in February 1989. But the invasion’s infamous legacy remains visible in many ways, including the landmines strewn across the country that still kill Afghans. Robert D Kaplan in his Soldiers of God cites a few studies to argue that the Soviet Union killed 1.3 million people in Afghanistan, a toll exceeding the death toll of the Iran-Iraq war and equivalent to the toll of 75 Israeli invasions of Lebanon on the scale of the 1982 invasion.

Today, Russia is back in Afghanistan, not to invade or install a pro-communist government, but to do business with those at the helm. It removed the Taliban from its terrorist list in April 2025, recognised their government that July, and in May 2026, signed a military-technical cooperation agreement with them. Though the terms are not public, reports suggest it covers the repair and maintenance of Russian and Soviet-made equipment. It is a long way from the 1990s, when Moscow backed the Northern Alliance against the first Taliban regime.

The irony is hard to miss. Russia is trying to mediate between the Taliban – heirs of the very mujahideen that drove them out of the country – and Pakistan, which financed, trained, and nurtured them.

For Russia, the Afghanistan-Pakistan landscape resembles a chessboard. Chess is a two-player game. But those who practise alone know the trick of playing both sides. That is Moscow’s current strategy. Any pawn moved from Afghanistan’s side has to be met with another in Pakistan, and Russia must anticipate both carefully. It just so happens that chess is a beloved pastime in Russia.

The point is that both countries have always been interlinked in Russia’s strategic calculations, as they have been in those of many other regional and extra-regional players. For instance, when it was clear that the Soviets were losing to the mujahideen by 1987, their best hope was to “destabilise the guerrillas’ rear base” in Pakistan. Kaplan writes that the US State Department reported over a hundred terrorist incidents in Pakistan cities that year, with Pakistan suffering one third of all the fatalities and one half of the wounded in terrorist attacks worldwide in 1987. A Russia that once exploited the link between the two countries to bleed its enemy now hopes to sustain that link.

Today, Russia seeks a stable Afghanistan where the Islamic State Khorasan Province (ISKP) won’t find breathing space and where instability and chaos do not spill into Central Asian states that Moscow still treats as its sphere of influence. This intent is clear from the head of Russia’s Federal Security Service warning that ISKP, based in Afghanistan, is recruiting members from Central Asian states. A report by Afghanistan International goes even further, claiming that Russia is funding and equipping a special Taliban unit to counter ISKP.

Besides, on October 15-16, Moscow, which holds the chairmanship of the Collective Security Treaty Organization (CSTO) this year, hosted a joint meeting between the CSTO, the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) and the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS). The theme was security in Central Asia and Afghanistan. Read alongside the three simultaneous visits, Russia’s layered Afghanistan strategy comes through. A larger delegation led by the Russian Deputy Prime Minister is due soon in Afghanistan.

Also read: Moscow Format has become a talk-shop. Afghanistan is receding from global agenda

Russia, an unlikely mediator
Afghanistan will not stabilise as long as it remains locked in ‘open war’ with Pakistan. So, Moscow is engaging Islamabad too. But its embrace of the Taliban may complicate matters, as may its reported mediation . If Russia sees the Taliban as a counterterrorism partner in the fight against the ISKP threat, then Pakistan holds the Taliban responsible for terrorism on its soil and for harbouring the Pakistani Taliban. Moscow still acknowledges terrorism emanating from Afghanistan, but it distinguishes that from the Taliban administration.

When fighting erupted along the Afghanistan-Pakistan border earlier this month, the Russian embassy in Kabul tweeted , “We are seriously concerned about the ongoing military confrontation between Pakistan and Afghanistan, which affects civilians, including children”. Many read this as tilting towards the Taliban, which accuses Pakistan of killing civilians in airstrikes in Afghanistan, a charge Pakistan obstinately denies.

Others have tried to play this role. China, Qatar, Turkey and Saudi Arabia have all attempted to mediate between Islamabad and Kabul. At best they have secured temporary ceasefires that were quickly punctured, or agreements without written or verifiable mechanisms. On October 5, the Russia-led Moscow Format Consultations on Afghanistan could not produce a joint communique because of Taliban-Pakistan tensions over terrorism.

Russia, moreover, has historical baggage that it brings to the table as a potential intercessor. Pakistani security analyst Muhammad Amir Rana wrote in a column for Dawn , “Is it not interesting that the conventional wars fought by India and Pakistan collectively may not have lasted for more than a few weeks, and that Pakistan fought its longest war against the Soviet Union in Afghanistan?…The Pakistani leadership still takes pride in that success.”

The present is an obstacle too. If Russia indeed is arming the Taliban, Pakistan may fear the weapons will be turned on it. Russia can still bring both sides to the table. It holds real leverage over the Taliban, which will want to preserve Russian recognition and the cooperation that comes with it, and Pakistan has reason to use Russia’s proximity to the Taliban to give dialogue a chance.

From fighting the mujahideen to courting their successors, Russia is rewriting its place in the region’s history. In some respects, it is whitewashing its past. Whatever the consequence of the current not-so-great game Russia is playing, they will reinforce how short the world’s collective memory of Afghanistan can be.

items.title: サッカー＝レアル、Ｓリーグ設立費用の負担要請　プレミア6クラブに
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２０日　ロイター］ - サッカーのスペイン１部、レアル・マドリードが、欧州スーパーリーグの立ち上げ直後に撤退したイングランド・プレミアリーグの６クラブに対し、設立関連費用の負担を求めていることが分かった。

スポーツ専門メディア「ジ・アスレチック」によると、費用総額は８０００万ユーロ（約１４２億円）に達する可能性がある。同メディアは各クラブが大会の運営母体で持株会社「欧州スーパーリーグ・カンパニー」の株主間協定に署名したと報じているが、契約に設立費用の負担義務が付帯しているかどうかは不明。

欧州スーパーリーグは２０２１年に欧州トップの１２クラブが構想を発表。しかし、強い批判にさらされ、創設からわずか３日で９クラブが撤退したことで立ち行かなくなった。レアルはこのうち、アーセナル、チェルシー、リバプール、マンチェスター・シティー、マンチェスター・ユナイテッド、トットナムの６クラブについて、費用を負担すべきだとコメントした。

同クラブは設立費用について、自身とユベントス（イタリア）、バルセロナ（スペイン）が負担してきたと指摘。なお、早期撤退した９クラブのうち残り３クラブ、ＡＣミラン、インテル（以上イタリア）、アトレチコ・マドリード（スペイン）についても支払いを求めているかどうかは、現時点で明らかにしていない。

ロイターの問い合わせに対し、トットナムはコメントを控えた。その他５クラブからは直ちに回答を得られていない。

欧州スーパーリーグは９クラブが抜けた後、ユベントスもプロジェクトから撤退し、続いてバルセロナも離脱。創設クラブとしてレアルのみが最後まで残る結果となっていた。

items.title: Morning Bid: Tesla may get rocket boosters for real this time
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A look at the day ahead in European and global markets from Gregor Stuart Hunter
items.body:
A look at the day ahead in European and global markets from Gregor Stuart Hunter
Just days after strapping [USN:L1N46200L TEXT:"thrusters onto"] the new Roadster, Elon Musk may be about to repeat the stunt for real this time with a far bigger boost for Tesla (TSLA.O) — by combining the EV maker with SpaceX (SPCX.O) .
The mercurial industrialist said on Tuesday that a merger of the two companies would be "[USN:L4N4661M0 TEXT:"a good idea"]" and that they had formed special committees to discuss a union, sending shares of the Starlink operator up 8% in extended trading. The tie-up would create one of the [USN:L6N46214X TEXT:"most valuable companies"] in the world, worth about $3.5 trillion and in fifth place globally, between Microsoft (MSFT.O) and Amazon (AMZN.O) .
But Musk faces substantial regulatory risks from merging the two. Top of mind among governments may be who ordered the slowdown of a military-grade version of the Starlink satellite service that Ukraine relies on in its war with Russia. The Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday that Musk had given the order last week, citing US officials and people familiar with the matter. Reuters could not independently verify the [USN:L6N4661BY TEXT:"report"].
Analysts on Tesla's Q3 earnings conference call later may be tempted to ask: Whatever happened to the last Roadster that Musk blasted into outer space in 2018, anyway?
Elsewhere, Australian data centre operator NextDC (NXT.AX) shed nearly half of its value after sharply [USN:L4N4661TS TEXT:"cutting revenue forecasts"] for the year ahead and putting future developments on hold, extending the burst of negative sentiment towards global AI stocks.
But shares in South Korean artificial intelligence infrastructure company Elice Group (0158S0.KQ) [USN:P8N44T04P TEXT:"surged"] 30% on Wednesday morning, rebounding from a slump in its market debut on Tuesday.
Markets in Asia have been fairly well-behaved otherwise: MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan (.MISX00000PUS) was up 1.2%, as the KOSPI (.KS11) hit a one-week high. The Nikkei 225 (.N225) gained 1.3%, while S&P 500 e-mini futures were up 0.4%.
Brent crude climbed 1.5% to $110.41 per barrel in [USN:L1N46601X TEXT:"Asian trade"] on Middle East supply concerns, with investors wary of Red Sea shipping risks and threats to oil infrastructure in Saudi Arabia, and peace talks between the US and Iran still elusive following a choppy session for oil markets on Tuesday.
In early European trading, pan-region futures were up 0.4%, German DAX futures gained 0.4% and FTSE futures were flat.
And after a downgrade threat from MSCI triggered a rout in the Jakarta Composite (.JKSE) , [USN:L4N467044 TEXT:"Bank Indonesia"] prepares to decide interest rate policy later. In a departure from its usual programme, the central bank has brought forward Wednesday's policy rate press conference to 1330 local time (0630 GMT), 30 minutes earlier than usual, without providing details. Stay tuned.
Key developments that could influence markets on Wednesday:
Company earnings:
Meta, Tesla, Lam Research, Philip Morris International, SAP SE
Economic events:
United Kingdom CPI, PPI, RPI, RPI-X and PSNB ex-banks for September

items.title: 米駐日大使がロシアを非難　邦人記者拘束は「報道を威嚇するあからさまな試み」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Tamiyuki Kihara

[東京 ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Tamiyuki Kihara

[東京 ２１日 ロイター] - 北海道新聞の邦人男性記者がロシア当局にスパイ容疑で拘束されたことについて、米国のグラス駐日大使は２１日、自身のソーシャルメディア「Ｘ」への投稿でロシア側の対応を非難した。日本外務省は担当局長を現地に派遣するなど、記者との領事面会や解放に向けた働きかけを続けている。

グラス氏は投稿の中で、今回の記者拘束を「独立した報道を威嚇し、口封じしようとするあからさまな試みに他ならない」と強調。表現の自由を、自由で活力に満ちた社会の礎石と位置づける米として、「（記者の）拘束と領事面会を拒絶するロシアを非難する」とも記した。

日本外務省の中村仁威・欧州局長は２０日、モスクワのロシア外務省を訪れ、ボロビヨワ・アジア第３局長と会談した。日本政府によると、中村氏は領事面会の一刻も早い実現や記者の即時解放を求めた。ロシア側の反応について木原稔官房長官は２１日午前の記者会見で、「外交上のやり取りなので、先方の反応を含めて詳細は差し控える」と述べるにとどめた。

その上で、木原氏は「政府としては引き続き、一刻も早い領事面会の実現、何よりも邦人の即時解放、人道的配慮及び公正・公平な取り扱いをロシア側に強く求め、邦人保護の観点から全力で取り組んでいく」と語った。

（鬼原民幸　編集：橋本浩）

items.title: Bowler Shami not giving up hope of India return
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Mohammed Shami said he was determined to work his way back into the India team after the injury-plagued fast bowler was again left out of the squad for their multi-format tour of New Zealand.
items.body:
Mohammed Shami said he was determined to work his way back into the India team after the injury-plagued fast bowler was again left out of [USN:L4N4621F5 TEXT:"the squad"] for their multi-format tour of New Zealand.
Shami has taken 462 international wickets in 197 matches across all three formats but last featured for India in March 2025 during their successful Champions Trophy campaign, in which he was the team's joint-highest wicket-taker.
The 36-year-old, whose career has been disrupted by leg issues, told reporters on Tuesday he would never lose hope of returning to the international arena.
"In any profession, you shouldn't leave hope. You should always have a goal," he said. "If we are playing in the Ranji Trophy, it is to win the title for the state, right? Goals should always be there. I don't deny that I have that goal."
Shami was dropped by Bengal for their Ranji Trophy match against Services last week but he said that decision was based on the pitch being better for spin and that his fitness was not the issue.
"I am still at my peak," he added. "You all can see it for yourselves, I trained today and yesterday as well."
Shami was the leading wicket-taker when India won the 2023 ODI World Cup on home soil but looks unlikely to feature in their title defence next year.
"I don't think that far ahead. You never know what will happen in life," he said. "You don't know who will score runs or take wickets."
India begin their five-match T20 series against New Zealand on Thursday, with five more ODIs and a two-test series to follow.

items.title: 米セールスフォース、56億6000万ドルでブレイズを買収
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Anzar Mehraj

[２０日 ロイター] - 米顧客管理ソフトウエア大手のセールスフォースは２０日、顧客エンゲージメント基盤を展開するブレイズ
items.body:
Anzar Mehraj

[２０日 ロイター] - 米顧客管理ソフトウエア大手のセールスフォースは２０日、顧客エンゲージメント基盤を展開するブレイズ を約５６億６０００万ドルで買収すると発表した。人工知能（ＡＩ）戦略を強化する一環となる。

発表後にブレイズの株価は５０％超上昇した。

セールスフォースはブレイズ株を１株当たり４７．５０ドルで買い取る。これは前営業日の終値に約５８．１％上乗せした価格となる。

ブレイズはそれぞれの顧客に応じたメッセージを送信するとともに、顧客の行動にリアルタイムで対応できるツールを手がけている。キャンバやインスタカート、ベンモなど計約２７７０社の顧客に対し、マーケッターがコンテンツや商品提供、販路を最適化できるように支援するＡＩツールを提供している。

フューチュラム・エクイティーズのチーフ・マーケット・ストラテジスト、シェイ・ボロア氏は「セールスフォースは基本的に、自社のマーケティング事業がこれまで欠いていたリアルタイムのエンゲージメント層を買収することになる」と指摘した。

セールスフォースは契約を破棄した場合、３億ドルの違約金を支払う。一方、ブレイズが契約を破棄した場合には１億９１４０万ドルの違約金を支払う。

セールスフォースの専属財務アドバイザーはＪＰモルガン・セキュリティーズ、ブレイズのアドバイザーはカタリスト・パートナーズがそれぞれ務めている。

セールスフォースはＡＩ戦略を進める一環として、自律型ＡＩエージェントプラットフォームを手がけるフィンを約３６億ドルで買収することを今年発表。昨年には、データ管理ソフトを手がける米インフォマティカを約８０億ドルで買収すると公表した。

セールスフォースは契約を破棄した場合、３億ドルの違約金を支払う。一方、ブレイズが契約を破棄した場合には１億９１４０万ドルの違約金を支払う。

セールスフォースの専属財務アドバイザーはＪＰモルガン・セキュリティーズ、ブレイズのアドバイザーはカタリスト・パートナーズがそれぞれ務めている。

セールスフォースはＡＩ戦略を進める一環として、自律型ＡＩエージェントプラットフォームを手がけるフィンを約３６億ドルで買収することを今年発表。昨年には、データ管理ソフトを手がける米インフォマティカを約８０億ドルで買収すると公表した。

items.title: Russian drones kill two people near Ukraine's Kharkiv overnight, governor says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Russian drones killed two people near Ukraine's second-largest city of Kharkiv overnight, Regional Governor Oleh Syniehubov said on Telegram on Wednesday.
items.body:
Russian drones killed two people near Ukraine's second-largest city of Kharkiv overnight, Regional Governor Oleh Syniehubov said on Telegram on Wednesday.
Another 11 people suffered stress reactions in the attack that struck private houses and caused other damage, he said.
In Ukraine's capital of Kyiv, a Russian airstrike hit a high-storey apartment building and transport infrastructure, causing fires, Mayor Vitalii Klitschko said on Telegram.
There was also a strike on a university in Kremenchuk in the Poltava region that injured two, local authorities said.
The fresh strikes came ahead of a [USN:L1N466099 TEXT:"meeting"] scheduled between US envoy Steve Witkoff and Russian President Vladimir Putin on Wednesday.
A US official said Witkoff had "constructive" talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy in Norway on Tuesday.

items.title: Evan Bouchard scores OT winner on birthday to lift Oilers over Wild
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Evan Bouchard scored the overtime winner on his 27th birthday as the Edmonton Oilers survived the visiting Minnesota Wild's comeback effort to win 4-3 on Tuesday.
items.body:
Evan Bouchard scored the overtime winner on his 27th birthday as the Edmonton Oilers survived the visiting Minnesota Wild's comeback effort to win 4-3 on Tuesday.
Edmonton's Leon Draisaitl scored twice on the power play to give him five goals in his past four games, while Connor McDavid collected three assists to increase his league-leading total to 26 points (six goals, 20 assists).
Mathieu Joseph added a goal and Devon Levi finished with 27 saves as the Oilers improved to 7-1-1.
Kirill Kaprizov notched his league-leading 11th goal and added an assist for the Wild, who had been on a 4-1-0 run. Minnesota's Joel Eriksson Ek and Ryan Hartman also found the back of the net, and Jesper Wallstedt made 28 saves in the losing effort.
Bouchard ended the contest 3:32 into overtime, wiring a wrist shot past Wallstedt for the game-clinching power-play tally after Minnesota was penalized for too many men on the ice.
Draisaitl is the only other Edmonton player ever to register an overtime goal on his birthday, having accomplished the feat on Oct. 27, 2024.
Eriksson Ek followed up on his own rebound and jammed it past Levi to give the Wild the initial lead 3:32 into the first period.
The Oilers capitalized on a 5-on-3 power play late in the first period when Draisaitl one-timed a pass from McDavid past an outstretched Wallstedt with 2.9 seconds left.
Draisaitl swiftly struck again just over a minute into the middle frame as McDavid spotted him open in front to hook up for his second consecutive power-play tally.
Joseph knocked home a loose puck that trickled through Wallstedt at 6:01 of the second period to give Edmonton a 3-1 lead.
Moments after Kaprizov found the post with a backhand attempt, Bouchard walked in at the other end and blasted a powerful wrist shot off the crossbar with 4:31 left in the second.
Kaprizov made it a one-goal game with 9:30 left in the third as he wired a wrist shot over Levi's glove.
Hartman knotted the contest just over two minutes later, picking up a pass from Bobby Brink and firing home his first goal of the season.
Wallstedt made several key saves while Minnesota was short-handed in overtime before Bouchard finally beat him to end it.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Bangladesh yet to receive Saudi response on execution of two nationals
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Saudi Arabia has not yet responded to Dhaka's queries about the execution of two Bangladeshi nationals, which was carried out without notifying Bangladeshi authorities, foreign ministry spokesperson Shahidul Karim said on Wednesday.
items.body:
Saudi Arabia has not yet responded to Dhaka's queries about the execution of two Bangladeshi nationals, which was carried out without notifying Bangladeshi authorities, foreign ministry spokesperson Shahidul Karim said on Wednesday.
State Minister for Foreign Affairs Shama Obaed Islam said earlier this week that Dhaka has sought clarification on the circumstances of the executions, which were carried out on October 14
The government has asked for copies of the court verdicts, details about the offenses and an explanation of why Bangladesh's diplomatic mission was not informed, she added
Saudi Arabia is Bangladesh's largest overseas labour market and home to an estimated 3.5 million Bangladeshi workers who send home major remittances, making migrant welfare a key bilateral issue
The Saudi embassy in Dhaka did not immediately respond to a request for comment
Saudi Arabia's interior ministry said a man and a woman were executed after being convicted for committing indecent acts inside a mosque in the holy city of Makkah, Saudi media reported
Islam said the government would decide on next steps after receiving the case details and documents and discussing the matter with Saudi authorities
(This story has been corrected to say Wednesday, not Tuesday, in paragraph 1, and to say that a man and a woman, not two men, were executed, in the fifth bullet point)

items.title: アマゾン、来年独に160 億ユーロ超投資へ　欧州事業拡大の一環
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２０日 ロイター] - 米アマゾン・ドット・コムは２０日、２０２７年にドイツに１６０億ユーロ超（約１８０億ドル）を投資する計画を明らかにした。クラウドコンピューティング、人工知能（ＡＩ）、衛星インターネット、メディア事業を拡大する。

ＡＩサービスへの需要が急増し、ハイテク企業間の競争が激化する中、アマゾンが目指すのは欧州事業の成長で、欧州全域においてクラウドインフラの拡大を急いでいる。

ベルリンで開催された投資関連の会議で発表された今回の投資計画は、アマゾンが２０１０年以降にドイツに投資してきた１０００億ユーロ超に上乗せされる。新たな投資には、クラウド部門ＡＷＳのフランクフルトにあるデータセンター群（リージョン）とＡＩインフラの拡充に向けた４８億ユーロが含まれている。

また３０００人超の雇用創出が見込まれる新たな物流プロジェクト、低軌道（ＬＥＯ）衛星インターネットサービスの開発、動画配信サービス「プライム・ビデオ」の新作制作も含まれる。

さらに、アマゾンはベルリンに２カ所目となるロボット工学・ＡＩ研究施設を開設する計画。

今回の発表は２４年６月に発表された、ドイツ国内のクラウドインフラと物流ネットワークの拡大に向けた１００億ユーロの投資に続くもので、それにはＡＷＳデータセンター向けの８８億ユーロが含まれている。

items.title: In China, ECB makes case for euro liquidity lines
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The European Central Bank can strengthen the euro's global role and amplify the reach of its monetary policy by providing liquidity safety nets to foreign countries, ECB chief economist Philip Lane said on Wednesday.
items.body:
The European Central Bank can strengthen the euro's global role and amplify the reach of its monetary policy by providing liquidity safety nets to foreign countries, ECB chief economist Philip Lane said on Wednesday.
Speaking at a closed-door event in Shanghai titled "Monetary System Beyond the Dollar", Lane said demand for the ECB's [USN:L4N3ZA02V TEXT:"recently expanded"] euro liquidity facilities had been strong, with [USN:L8N41L3LR TEXT:"more than 30"] central banks expressing interest.
"Liquidity lines bolster confidence in the currency and reduce the associated risks, supporting its wider usage," he told the event, part of the annual Bund summit, according to prepared remarks.
The comments come as [USN:L6N44R03N TEXT:"policymakers"] globally question the the long-term dominance of the dollar in light of US President Donald Trump's [USN:L6N451164 TEXT:"unpredictable economic policy"].
Lane argued that greater international use of the euro would enhance the ECB's ability to deliver on its inflation mandate by extending the global impact of euro area monetary policy.
He said the ECB's [USN:L8N3ZA06W TEXT:"EUREP facility"], which allows foreign central banks to obtain euros against collateral denominated in the single currency, could boost bond markets in the 21-country bloc, particularly through increased purchases by official reserve managers.
ECB President Christine Lagarde [USN:L1N45K0J8 TEXT:"said recently"] that the bank was also reviewing its network of currency swap lines, which allow major central banks, including the US Federal Reserve and the People's Bank of China, to exchange their own currencies for euros.
Lane said such arrangements can encourage borrowing in euros but should be reserved for central banks in economies with close financial links to the euro area and a clear capacity to repay euro liabilities.

items.title: Japan envoy Sasakawa meets Myanmar's Min Aung Hlaing, state media says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Myanmar's junta chief-turned-president Min Aung Hlaing met on Tuesday with Japanese philanthropist Yohei Sasakawa in the capital Naypyitaw, state media reported, as international re-engagement with the Southeast Asian nation ramps up after years of diplomatic isolation.
items.body:
Myanmar's junta chief-turned-president Min Aung Hlaing met on Tuesday with Japanese philanthropist Yohei Sasakawa in the capital Naypyitaw, state media reported, as international re-engagement with the Southeast Asian nation ramps up after years of diplomatic isolation.
Sasakawa, the honorary chair of the Nippon Foundation who also serves as Japan's special envoy for national reconciliation in Myanmar, met with Min Aung Hlaing on Tuesday, the state-run Global New Light of Myanmar newspaper reported on Wednesday
During their talks, the two discussed plans for Sasakawa to provide assistance to "Myanmar's internal peace process", as well as support from the foundation to develop the country's human resources, the newspaper reported
Myanmar has been in turmoil since a 2021 military coup led by Min Aung Hlaing deposed an elected civilian government, triggering a nationwide civil war that has killed more than 100,000 people and displaced over 3.5 million
Japan's foreign ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the visit by Sasakawa, who has long been involved in mediating between Myanmar's military and the armed groups opposed to it
In 2022, Sasakawa helped broker a truce between the Myanmar military and the Arakan Army rebel group in Rakhine, according to the Nippon Foundation
However, the ceasefire has since collapsed, leading to renewed fighting
The United States has already started to [USN:L6N45T16N TEXT:"re-engage with Myanmar"], with the two countries holding talks in Tokyo this month
Japan's acting envoy to Myanmar [USN:L1N4610AA TEXT:"also met with"] the Myanmar foreign minister in October in their first known public engagement, which followed a September visit to Naypyitaw by Japanese ruling party lawmaker Hiromichi Watanabe

items.title: Overseas New Zealanders can start voting from Wednesday
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: New Zealanders living or travelling overseas can vote in the country's 2026 general election from Wednesday, ahead of advance voting starting next week in New Zealand.
items.body:
New Zealanders living or travelling overseas can vote in the country's 2026 general election from Wednesday, ahead of advance voting starting next week in New Zealand.
New Zealand's general election will take place on November 7 with recent opinion polls showing no party, or likely coalition grouping, with a clear majority.
New Zealand Chief Electoral Officer Karl Le Quesne said overseas voters could download their voting papers from the official election website and return them by uploading them to the site.
The Electoral Commission is also offering in-person or postal voting at 64 overseas locations, including 10 in Australia, home to the largest share of overseas-enrolled New Zealand voters.
About 126,000 enrolled voters have told the commission they are living overseas, compared with 92,600 in 2023. Nearly two-thirds of them are in Australia.

items.title: 米航空宇宙・軍事関連企業、今年利益見通し軒並み上げ　需要堅調
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Rajesh Kumar Singh　Aatreyee Dasgupta　Mike Stone

[２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Rajesh Kumar Singh　Aatreyee Dasgupta　Mike Stone

[２０日 ロイター] - 米航空宇宙・防衛関連企業ノースロップ・グラマンとＲＴＸは２０日、軍事プログラムからの堅調な需要により受注残高が過去最高水準に達したことを受け、通期利益見通しを引き上げた。

民間航空宇宙サービスに対する持続的な需要もＲＴＸを押し上げたほか、競合するエンジンメーカーのＧＥエアロスペースは今年２度目となる通期見通し上方修正を行った。

ＲＴＸ傘下レイセオンの第３・四半期売上高は１４％増。海軍プログラムや、「パトリオット」、「スタンダード・ミサイル」、「トマホーク」を含む陸上・防空システムの販売増にけん引された。

ＲＴＸは自社の受注残高が前年比３６％増の３４００億ドルとなり、「再び過去最高を更新した」と明らかにした。

「Ｂ２１レイダー」爆撃機や「Ｆ３５」戦闘機部品を製造するノースロップは、航空システム部門で同様に１４％の売上増を記録。同社の受注残高は９月３０日時点で過去最高の１０９６億ドルに達した。

ＧＥエアロスペースも同様に堅調な需要を記録し、民間用エンジンおよびサービス事業の売上高は２割以上増加して１０３億４０００万ドルとなった。

しかし同社は、燃料価格の高止まりが長期化すれば、航空会社が運航を縮小し、エンジンの修理、予備部品、予備エンジンに対する需要が弱まる可能性があることを認めた。

items.title: Alsea revierte caída en ventas de Starbucks en México gracias a Snoopy y bebidas de temporada
items.author: Italia López
items.summary: La empresa reportó un crecimiento de 3,1% anual en las ventas a mismas tiendas del segmento de cafeterías durante el tercer trimestre.
items.body: Ciudad de México — Starbucks México, la cadena de cafeterías operada en el país por Alsea ( ALSEA* ), se recuperó del tropiezo en ventas del trimestre previo apoyada en una colaboración con Peanuts y bebidas de temporada. La empresa reportó un crecimiento de 3,1% anual en las ventas a mismas tiendas del segmento de cafeterías durante el tercer trimestre, una métrica que mide a aquellas con más de un año en operación, luego de registrar una caída de 2% anual en el trimestre previo. Alsea atribuyó el resultado a la recuperación gradual de tráfico tras el Mundial 2026 y a un “sólido calendario comercial”, que incluyó una colección limitada de vasos y termos con Snoopy y otros personajes de Peanuts, las bebidas de temporada como el pumpkin spice latte, así como el regreso del Unicorn Frappuccino. Ver más: Analistas prevén tasa de interés sin cambios aun con miembros de Banxico abiertos a recortes La colaboración con Peanuts ya había probado su éxito en el pasado, Alsea reportó una alta demanda de la colección limitada que lanzó a finales de marzo de 2025; mientras el Unicorn Frapuccino se convirtió en un fenómeno en redes sociales cuando se lanzó en 2017. El director general de Alsea Starbucks, Jaime Vasquez, anticipó en septiembre que las innovaciones y bebidas de temporada ayudarían a mejorar las ventas a mismas tiendas de la cadena de cafeterías, que ha resentido el entorno de consumo débil en el país. La empresa reportó que México fue un motor de recuperación de las ventas a mismas tiendas, que a nivel consolidado crecieron 4,2% anual en el tercer trimestre, respecto al avance de 2,6% en el segundo trimestre, con un desempeño favorable en las principales marcas operadas por Alsea, como Starbucks y Domino’s Pizza. “El tercer trimestre de 2026 reflejó una clara aceleración en el desempeño de nuestro negocio”, dijo en el reporte Christian Gurría, CEO de Alsea. Ver más: Acciones de Aeroméxico caen con fuerza tras sus resultados: qué decepcionó a Wall Street Las ventas consolidadas de Alsea crecieron 2% anual en el periodo julio-septiembre, a MXN$21.397 millones, mientras el flujo operativo EBITDA retrocedió 0,7%, a MXN$4.396 millones y las ganancias incrementaron 48,4%, a MXN$545 millones. “La empresa presentó un reporte trimestral positivo, principalmente por la recuperación secuencial de Starbucks México, sumado al fortalecimiento del ecosistema digital”, escribió Ariel Méndez, analista bursátil de Bx+, en una nota. La analista advirtió que persisten retos relacionados con el consumo en Sudamérica y la volatilidad cambiaria. Además de Starbucks y Domino’s Pizza, Alsea opera marcas como Burger King, Italianni’s, Chili’s y Cheesecake Factory en varios países de Latinoamérica y en Europa.

items.title: 中国による偽情報拡散が増加、台湾当局が警告　統一地方選控え
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Yimou Lee

[台北 ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Yimou Lee

[台北 ２１日 ロイター] - 台湾の情報機関である国家安全局は、中国が２０２６年１─９月に台湾を標的としてネット上で拡散した、真偽に争いがある情報や虚偽情報が２５０万件を超えたと明らかにした。来月の統一地方選を控え、中国政府が工作を強化していると非難した。

同局が今週、立法院（国会）に提出した報告書によると、こうした情報は１─９月に前年同期の１６９万件余りから約４８％増えた。

中国発の情報は、エネルギー、食料安全保障、防衛政策のほか、特定候補の政策やイメージに焦点を当てており、１１月の地方選に影響を及ぼす狙いがあるという。

中国政府で台湾政策を担う国務院台湾事務弁公室はコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。中国政府は台湾側の反対にもかかわらず台湾を自国領土と見なしているが、台湾の選挙への干渉や偽情報の拡散については否定している。

報告書によると、中国政府はしばしば公式メディアを通じて特定の筋書きを作り出した上で、「ネット工作部隊」や広報会社を通じて拡散し、台湾の人々の間に対立を生じさせようとしている。その手法には、コンテンツを大量生産するサイト、人工知能（ＡＩ）で生成した動画、偽アカウント、組織的なコメントの大量投稿などが含まれる。

報告書は「中国はＡＩ技術の活用を拡大して情報を操作し、有権者の支持と選挙結果に影響を与えようとしている」と指摘した。

items.title: Gold dips for fourth session as oil rally fans inflation concerns
items.author: Sukanya Mitra
items.creator: Sukanya Mitra
items.summary: Gold eased for a fourth straight session on Wednesday as higher oil prices stoked inflationary concerns, while investors looked ahead to next week's Federal Reserve policy meeting for clues on the future path of interest rates.
items.body:
Gold eased for a fourth straight session on Wednesday as higher oil prices stoked inflationary concerns, while investors looked ahead to next week's Federal Reserve policy meeting for clues on the future path of interest rates.
Spot gold was down 0.1% at $4,119.37 per ounce by 0516 GMT, while US gold futures for December delivery slipped 0.1% to $4,137.00.
"The metal could remain under some pressure as crude prices returned to the upside, keeping inflationary pressures in place and reinforcing hawkish monetary policy expectations," said Bas Kooijman, CEO and asset manager of DHF Capital S.A.
Oil prices [USN:L4N4661ZE TEXT:"edged higher"] on Middle East supply concerns, with traders wary of Red Sea shipping risks and threats to oil infrastructure in [USN:S8N44M08Y TEXT:"Saudi Arabia"].
"At this point, if some of these rate hikes that the markets have baked in for next year fall out of the forecast or at least downgrade in their likelihood, then that's likely to send gold higher," said Ilya Spivak, head of global macro at Tastylive.
The Fed will skip raising interest rates this month and deliver a hike in December, according to nearly all economists [USN:L6N46606V TEXT:"polled by Reuters"], as policymakers signal patience even as stubborn inflation argues for a tougher response.
Expectations of a rate hike at the central bank's October 27-28 policy meeting are as low as 15%, while traders still see an 88% chance of a hike in December, according to CME's FedWatch Tool.
Higher interest rates typically weigh on gold prices because they increase the opportunity cost of holding the metal, which does not pay interest.
The US dollar index stabilised after recent losses, further weighing on bullion demand.
Markets are also waiting for US Personal Consumption Expenditures data next week, the Fed's preferred gauge to monitor its 2% inflation target.
Among other metals, spot silver slid 1.1% to $57.35 per ounce, platinum fell 0.6% to $1,639.47 and palladium dropped 1% to $1,091.78.

items.title: China says it is 'safeguarding order' around Taiwan-controlled South China Sea atoll
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: China's government said on Wednesday that its coast guard was "safeguarding order" around a tiny and strategically located Taiwan-controlled atoll at the top end of the South China Sea where Taipei fears Beijing is trying to enforce jurisdiction.
items.body:
China's government said on Wednesday that its coast guard was "safeguarding order" around a tiny and strategically located Taiwan-controlled atoll at the top end of the South China Sea where Taipei fears Beijing is trying to enforce jurisdiction.
China, which views democratically governed Taiwan as its own territory, said last week that Taiwan must "[USN:L1N46003D TEXT:"bear the consequences"]" of its coast guard using a water cannon against a Chinese fishing boat near the Pratas Islands.
Taiwan has reported two incidents since Sunday of Chinese coast guard vessels approaching the [USN:L1N46604S TEXT:"Pratas"], accusing Beijing of provocative behaviour.
Speaking at a regular news briefing, a spokesperson for China's Taiwan Affairs Office said Beijing has "indisputable sovereignty" over the South China Sea islands, including the Pratas and their adjacent waters.
"Mainland coast guard vessels conducting law enforcement patrols in the relevant waters are fulfilling their duties in accordance with the law, safeguarding normal navigation and operational order," spokesperson Zhang Han told reporters.
The Chinese ships are "effectively protecting the lawful and legitimate rights and interests of people on both sides of the Taiwan Strait and the safety of lives and property", she added.
The "obstinate insistence" by Taiwan's ruling party on its separatist stance is the root cause of the peril of war across the strait, Zhang said.
Taiwan's government rejects Beijing's territorial claims, saying only the Taiwanese people can decide their future.
China recognises no claims of sovereignty by Taiwan and has never renounced the use of force to bring the island under its control.
The Pratas have no permanent civilian population and lie roughly between southern Taiwan and Hong Kong. Security experts see them as vulnerable to Chinese attack due to their distance — more than 400 km (250 miles) — from Taiwan.
CHINESE 'LAW ENFORCEMENT' China's military already operates around Taiwan on an almost daily basis. Taipei has become increasingly alarmed by Beijing's use of its coast guard to carry out "[USN:L1N46603C TEXT:"law enforcement"]" patrols to try to assert jurisdiction.
Addressing a forum in Taipei late Tuesday, Taiwan's top China-policy maker said Beijing is attempting to "domesticate" the Taiwan issue to "create an illusion of having de facto jurisdiction over Taiwan's surrounding waters and offshore islands".
With President Xi Jinping expected to be confirmed for a fourth term in office next year, China's mission to "achieve national unification" becomes even more pressing, said Chiu Chui-cheng, head of the Mainland Affairs Council.
"We assess that Beijing's Taiwan policy will shift toward a more aggressive, provocative strategy of 'exercising jurisdiction before achieving unification'," he added.

items.title: Trump, in North Carolina, says Republicans will defy midterm odds
items.author: Jacob Bogage
items.creator: Jacob Bogage
items.summary: With his approval rating at record lows, President Donald Trump attempted to defy political gravity in a pep rally in North Carolina on Tuesday, urging voters to support his favored Senate candidate in a race some Republican groups have already given up on.
items.body:
With his approval rating at record lows, President Donald Trump attempted to defy political gravity in a pep rally in North Carolina on Tuesday, urging voters to support his favored Senate candidate in a race some Republican groups have already given up on.
Trump has embarked on a campaign blitz ahead of the November 3 [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm elections"], traveling more than 29,000 miles (46,671 km) since late September to boost Republican candidates — and his second stop in North Carolina in as many months was a signal of how much is at stake in this southern state.
Polls show former Democratic Governor Roy Cooper with a [USN:L6N4620WO TEXT:"commanding lead"] over Republican Michael Whatley, a former senior party official, in a Senate race that could help decide the balance of power in Washington.
The two are running to fill the seat of retiring Republican Thom Tillis, a one-time Trump ally, who split with the president over his landmark tax bill and defense policy.
Tillis told Politico in a Tuesday interview that his fellow Republicans were headed toward “a train wreck” and a "whoop ass" in November.
But Trump, speaking in the eastern city of Greenville on Tuesday night, predicted Whatley would prove the doubters wrong.
"I think you're gonna see some amazing results," he told hundreds of supporters who gathered on the grounds of the local airport. "They never poll us right. We have more spirit."
'WE NEED YOU' Trump won North Carolina in each of his three presidential runs, but Democrats are banking on a breakthrough performance this year, with polls showing a clear majority of Americans dissatisfied with rising prices and the war in Iran.
The president's approval rating has [USN:L6N465159 TEXT:"fallen to 31%,"] according to the latest Reuters/Ipsos survey, the lowest mark at any point during his two terms in office.
In early voting in North Carolina, Democrats have cast more ballots than Republicans by a two-to-one margin, according to state data.
Republican candidates on Tuesday night implored voters to turn out early.
"This is a Republican majority district," said Laurie Buckhout, a Trump-backed candidate running for a congressional seat in a mostly rural eastern district. “We have the momentum. We have the message. Now we need you."
Republicans hold 10 of the state's 14 House seats, but a handful of districts are viewed as battlegrounds this cycle — and have attracted significant spending.
Buckhout's race against Democratic Representative Don Davis has drawn $21 million in outside money since September 1, making it the third most expensive contest in the country, according to a Reuters analysis of campaign filings.
In the state's mountainous west, outside groups have spent $14.5 million on the race between Democrat Jamie Ager and Republican Jennifer Balkcom.
Whatley, by contrast, has largely been abandoned by the national party apparatus. The Senate Leadership Fund, the primary PAC supporting Republican candidates for the upper chamber, cut off spending in North Carolina earlier this month as Cooper posted double-digit leads in poll after poll.
'TIGHTEN THAT SHIP UP' Trump's popularity has cratered since he ordered military strikes on Iran in February alongside US ally Israel, triggering a surge in gasoline and diesel prices.
Some 68% of Americans disapprove of Trump's handling of the economy, Reuters/Ipsos has found, including 37% of self-identified Republicans.
Taylor Smith, who described herself as a housewife in Greenville, told Reuters she had only ever voted Republican, but the drama of the Trump administration had her thinking twice.
Disorganization within the White House was bleeding into policy, she said, revealing Trump’s lack of focus.
“Anything good that could be happening is being co-opted by the tomfoolery that's just going on,” Smith said.
"I hate these gas prices," she added, urging the president to “tighten that ship up.”
As he has in events across the country, Trump heralded what he said were new local investments on Tuesday night.
Sibelco, an industrial minerals mining and processing company, was expanding its operations in North Carolina, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick announced on stage without providing specifics.
Sibelco did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Trump said the US Defense Department would also invest $1.5 billion in semiconductor chip production in North Carolina, but did not say where or how the money would be spent.
Toward the end of his speech, the president [USN:S8N41C0VN TEXT:"repeated his promise"] to give $5,000 to every US adult should Republicans maintain their hold on Congress.
"If we lose," he said, "you get nothing."

items.title: 外務省局長がロシア訪問、拘束日本人の領事面会要請＝官房長官
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [東京 ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[東京 ２１日 ロイター] - 木原稔官房長官は２１日午前の記者会見で、外務省の中村仁威欧州局長がロシアを訪れて外務省のボロビヨワ・アジア第３局長と会談し、同国で拘束されている北海道新聞の男性記者について一刻も早い領事面会の実現や即時解放を申し入れたと明らかにした。

ロシア側の反応については、外交上のやり取りであることを理由に公表を控えた。今後も領事面会や即時解放のほか、拘束されている記者への人道的配慮や公正・公平な取り扱いをロシア側に「強く求めていく」とした。

外務省によると、中村局長は日ロ間の諸問題について、日本政府の立場に基づいて、申し入れや主張を行った。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [東京 ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[東京 ２１日 ロイター] - 木原稔官房長官は２１日午前の記者会見で、岩井コスモ証券の売買管理システムがサイバー攻撃を受けて顧客の意図しない売買注文の発注が確認されるなど、金融・証券業界で被害が拡大していることについて問われ、「金融サービスへの信頼を損なうことのないよう、金融庁において金融機関に適切かつ迅速な対応を促していきたい」と述べた。

同庁は９日付で金融機関に対し、サイバーセキュリティ対策強化に関する注意喚起を発出している。官房長官によると、岩井コスモ証券には今回の事案の原因分析と再発防止策の策定を求めている。

同社は２０日、既に公表済みの不正アクセスに関し、同じ１４日に売買管理システムへの攻撃も発生し、７口座分において顧客の意図しない売買注文が発注されたことを確認したと発表。顧客には個別に連絡し、すでに取引前の状態に戻す措置を完了したという。
