items.title: Australian central banker says inflation outlook worse, unsure about November rate hike
items.author: Wayne Cole, Stella Qiu
items.creator: Wayne Cole, Stella Qiu
items.summary: A top Australian central banker on Wednesday said tighter monetary policy was working to slow the economy but the inflation outlook had still worsened, leaving him unsure whether interest rates would need to rise further next month.
items.body:
A top Australian central banker on Wednesday said tighter monetary policy was working to slow the economy but the inflation outlook had still worsened, leaving him unsure whether interest rates would need to rise further next month.
Speaking at a Citi investment conference, Reserve Bank of Australia Deputy Governor Andrew Hauser said the bank's economists were still finalising their quarterly forecasts but the inflation outlook did look "materially worse", in part due to high oil prices.
Brent [USN:L1N46601X TEXT:"last traded"] above $110 a barrel, up from $102 a barrel when the central bank last met three weeks ago and lifted interest rates for a fourth time this year. It was more than 35% higher than the RBA had forecast in August.
"The monetary policy is working, labour market is easing, consumption growth is quite tepid, but there are still pockets of growth and the inflation outlook has deteriorated, so that's a pretty tricky balance," said Hauser.
"The challenge that's facing the board is do you do more to tackle high inflation? ... Or do we hold our horses to protect the labour market?" he added. "We're in a world of hard choices, and I think that's the reality here."
Hauser said monetary policy could not deal with an oil shock directly, but it did need to make sure that higher costs did not feed through to rising inflation expectations. Some in the community had started questioning if the RBA could bring inflation back to its 2%-3% target, he added.
NOVEMBER IS LIVE The central bank meets on November 2-3 to decide whether to raise its 4.60% cash rate for a fifth time this year. Markets now imply around a 50% chance rates will rise to 4.85% next month, up from 30% at the start of the week, and another rate rise is fully priced by March next year.
For Goldman Sachs, Hauser's comments were enough to tip the balance toward another rate increase in November.
"Today's remarks suggest the RBA continues to see risks to inflation and inflation expectations as tilted to the upside even with the delivered 100 bp tightening year-to-date and in our view — absent a downside surprise in the 3Q2026 CPI report — make a further hike in November more likely than not," they said in a note to clients.
Consumer price data due next week could show headline inflation climbing to 4.0% in the third quarter as the Gulf war stokes fuel costs. Crucially, core inflation is seen holding around 3.5% and uncomfortably far above the RBA's long-term target band of 2% to 3%.
Hauser said it was "pretty clear" that the inflation outcome would likely be higher than the RBA had forecast.
"Yes, we will study it carefully when we get the final number," he added. "And at the moment, certainly those numbers are causing us to ask whether there's less capacity in the economy than we previously thought."
[USN:P8N44M01S TEXT:"Minutes of the RBA's"] last meeting showed the board was still concerned inflation risks lay to the upside, even after lifting rates for a fourth time this year.
Since then, [USN:L1N46100L TEXT:"labour data"] have shown [USN:L1N46500C TEXT:"unemployment"] unexpectedly hit a five-year peak of 4.7% in September, while [USN:L1N45M19O TEXT:"house prices"] have fallen faster than policymakers foresaw.
Hauser noted the labour market had eased more than expected, and there had been some softening in household demand and the housing market, but still the unemployment rate was among the lowest in G20 countries.

[２０日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックの上半期純損失は前年同期の１３０億ドルから８０７億ドルへと大幅に拡大した。株式に転換可能な社債のフェアバリュー（公正価値）が上昇したことが主因。ロイターが新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）目論見書の草案を入手した。

赤字には、事業運営に伴う現金コストではなく、最終的にアンソロピックの株式に転換される可能性のある社債の推定価値上昇を反映した会計上の費用７２０億ドルが含まれている。

文書によると、同社は上半期にコンピューティング能力とインフラに９０億ドル近くを費やしており、これは前年同期の２３億ドルから増加した。

アンソロピックはロイターのコメント要請に応じなかった。

ＡＩ企業を巡っては高性能な生成ＡＩモデルの開発・運用に必要な半導体やデータセンター、計算資源への巨額投資が続いており、投資家の間で各社の財務状況への関心が高まっている。

ロイターが先週、ＩＰＯ準備会合に出席した投資家の話として報じたところによると、アンソロピックの第３・四半期（７─９月）売上高は前期比４５％増の１６８億ドルとなった。

またロイターは９月、アンソロピックが２０２５年に４２０億ドルの純損失を計上し、今後数年間でクラウドサービスや計算資源、インフラ関連で計５１８０億ドルの支出を計画していると伝えた。

同社の２５年の売上高は前年比で約１２倍の４６億ドル近くに拡大した一方、過去の資金調達に関連する負債評価損などを除いたベースでも、営業赤字は８０億ドルを超えたという。

BOJ to raise rates to 1.50% in December, sticking to quarterly pace: Reuters poll

TOKYO, Oct 21 : The Bank of Japan will raise interest rates in December to 1.50 per cent, following June and September increases, according to a majority of economists in a Reuters poll, keeping up a quicker pace in a campaign that started with just one rate rise a year.
Rising energy and import costs, worsened by a weak yen and the war in the Middle East, are adding to inflation pressure in Japan, and there are more forecasters expecting at least two more rate rises to 2.0 per cent by the middle of next year.
A period of relative stability in the yen, which spent most of the year under crushing selling pressure, triggering interventions from the Japanese authorities as well as the US Treasury, also supports the case for a December increase.
Last week, board member Junko Koeda said the central bank should not become overly cautious about raising rates, at their highest in 31 years, given the significant upside risks to inflation.

Nearly 70 per cent of economists, 54 of 78, in the October 13-19 survey expected the BOJ to raise its policy rate to 1.5 per cent this quarter, almost double the share in the previous poll.
Of the 54 respondents who specified a month, about 80 per cent chose December, while only 2 per cent chose the BOJ's next two-day policy meeting, which concludes on October 30.
"With rate hikes in the United States and Europe looking likely before year-end, there is a risk that yen selling could accelerate if the BOJ postpones its move until the new year," said Kazutaka Maeda, senior economist at Meiji Yasuda Research Institute.
The BOJ is unlikely to raise rates this month, while the US Federal Reserve and the European Central Bank are expected to raise borrowing costs in December, separate Reuters polls found.
"The economy is not overheating to the extent that would warrant consecutive rate hikes, and price developments are also within the BOJ's expected range," said Takeshi Minami, chief economist at Norinchukin Research Institute.
Sources have told Reuters many BOJ officials prefer to assess more data on how previous increases have affected financial conditions.
RATES TO REACH 2 per cent OR HIGHER
Looking into next year, 39 of 65 analysts, or 60 per cent, expected the policy rate to reach 1.75 per cent by end-June, a median unchanged from the September poll.
Almost half of 41 respondents who answered an additional question said 1.75 per cent would be the terminal rate. But the share expecting it to reach 2.00 per cent or more rose to 51 per cent, from 40 per cent in September and 36 per cent in August.
In September, two board members nominated by Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi who support looser fiscal policy opposed the decision to raise rates to 1.25 per cent. 
Traders saw the dissent as a sign the BOJ's rate-hike plans could continue to face opposition from Takaichi's administration, briefly pushing the yen lower.
Nearly three-quarters of respondents, or 23 of 32, said further dissenting votes when the Policy Board next raises rates could weigh on the yen, which is only about 4 per cent stronger than its 2026 low of around 164 per dollar.
"If the dissenting vote were cast in particular by a board member appointed under the Takaichi administration, it could be interpreted as the administration's attempt to restrain rate hikes, potentially heightening concerns that future policy tightening could fall behind the curve," said Kei Fujimoto, senior economist at Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Asset Management.
BOND ISSUANCE SEEN BELOW 40 TRILLION YEN
Japanese government bond (JGB) yields have risen recently alongside a global market rout, but also on expectations of further BOJ rate hikes and concerns Takaichi's big spending and tax-cut plans will worsen the country's already strained finances.
Takaichi has said the government aims to keep new bond issuance at around 40 trillion yen ($251 billion) for the fiscal 2027 budget. She reiterated on Monday Tokyo would "appropriately" control the size of its debt issuance.
Nearly two-thirds of economists surveyed, 15 of 23, said new issuance would be kept below 40 trillion yen.
"The government is likely keen to increase JGB issuance as a source of funding for growth investment," said Junya Takemoto, senior economist at Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation. 
"However, as it becomes more conscious of rising interest rates in the market, it may seek to contain issuance by undertaking a full-scale review of budgets for existing subsidies and funds, ensuring that JGB issuance does not differ markedly from historical levels."

items.body:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（20日）株はダウ主導で上昇、ドル下落　長期債利回り低下
7:06 配信

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）前のウォール街の標識。2021年7月、米ニューヨークで撮影。REUTERS/Andrew Kelly

＜為替＞ ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対し下落した。ドルは原油価格と米長期債利回りの低下に歩調を合わせるように下落。市場では、米国とイランの対立激化による影響のほか、米国のＡＩ（人工知能）関連企業に対する旺盛な資本流入が持続可能性が注目されている。

終盤の取引で、円は対ドルで０．２１％高の１５８．１４円。日本の財務省が実施した２０年利付国債入札で応札倍率が５．８４倍と、前回（４．０１倍）から大幅に上昇し、同入札としては過去最高を付けたことが円の支援材料になった。

ユーロはこの日の取引では対ドルで上昇したものの、市場ではフランスの財政状況の悪化や各地で広がる抗議活動への警戒感から、ユーロに対する慎重な見方が根強い。スウェーデンのハンデルスバンケンの外国為替ストラテジスト、トミー・フォンブロムセン氏は「フランスを巡る懸念はすぐには解消されない」と指摘。「フランスに対する弱気な見方は当面続くと見られるため、ユーロには一段の下落余地がある」と述べた。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 長期債利回りが低下した。ただ、安値拾いを背景とした人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の切り返しなどで米株式相場が上昇する中、不安定な動きとなり、この日の最低水準からは大きく戻した。

２０日はコアウィーブなどＡＩ関連株が切り返し、株式市場全体が上昇するにつれ、利回りはこの日の低下幅を縮小した。年限の短い国債の利回りは前日比で上昇した。

指標となる米１０年債利回りは１．５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下し、５．１２１％となった。一時は５．０７３％まで低下した。

ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、ＦＲＢが来週の金融政策会合で少なくとも２５ｂｐの利上げを実施する確率は１７．２％。１週間前の２２．１％、１カ月前の５７．６％から低下した。

３０年債利回りは４．２ｂｐ低下の５．４３１％。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ ダウ工業株３０種が１％上昇し、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種を上回る値上がりとなった。ヘルスケア株が相場を最も押し上げた一方、前日に反発したハイテク株は軟調だった。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の主要１１業種では、ヘルスケア株指数が上昇率首位となり、過去最高値を更新した。イーライリリーがＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種への押し上げ寄与度で首位となった。ユナイテッドヘルス、メルク、ジョンソン・エンド・ジョンソン（Ｊ＆Ｊ）、アムジェンはダウの上昇に寄与した。

スペースＸは取引終了後に発表した第３・四半期利益が市場予想を大幅に上回り、時間外取引で株価が４％上昇した。

ネットフリックスは取引終了後に発表した第４・四半期の利益見通しが市場予想を下回り、株価は６％下落した。

メタとテスラは２１日に決算発表を予定している。

ゼネラル・モーターズ（ＧＭ）は６．８％急落。コモディティー（商品）価格の上昇とトラック販売の減少が今後数カ月の業績を圧迫するとの見通しを示した。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 年内の追加利上げ観測が高まったことから、金相場は下落した。中心限月１２月物の清算値は前日比０．４％安の１オンス＝４１４２．６０ドル。スポット金は午後２時５分（日本時間午前３時５分）時点で０．３％安の１オンス＝４１２５．９０ドルだった。 

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ 取引時間中に５カ月ぶりの高値を付けた後、反落して取引を終えた。イランのペゼシュキアン大統領とパキスタン軍トップのムニール陸軍元帥のテヘランでの会談や、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派のサウジアラビアのインフラに対する攻撃継続、湾岸での船舶攻撃の報道など材料が交錯した。    清算値は、北海ブレント先物が０．７６ドル（０．６９％）安の１バレル＝１０８．７９ドル。取引時間中に一時、期近物が１１１．９９ドルと、５カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。    米ＷＴＩ先物１１月限は１．８７ドル（１．８％）安の１０１．７９ドル。一時、１１０．４８ドルの高値を付け、期近物として４月以来の高水準となった。より取引が活発な１２月限は０．７２ドル安の９７．８２ドル。 

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

items.body:
Oscar-Winning star Eva Marie Saint’s cause of death disclosed The cause of death of Oscar-winning actress Eva Marie Saint has been revealed.
ANI | Updated: 21-10-2026 10:30 IST | Created: 21-10-2026 10:30 IST

Eva Marie Saint (Image source: Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

The cause of death of Oscar-winning actress Eva Marie Saint has been revealed. As per a death certificate obtained by PEOPLE, the actress died following the onset of cardiopulmonary arrest.
Eva breathed her last on October 6. She is survived by her husband of more than six decades, television director Jeffrey Hayden, their two children, Darrell and Laurette, four grandchildren and two great-grandchildren.Born on July 4, 1924, in Newark, New Jersey, Saint studied at Bowling Green State University in Ohio. She began her career in television and radio before making her Broadway debut in The Trip to Bountiful in 1953, according to PEOPLE magazine.
As per the publication, Saint made her film debut in 1954 with Elia Kazan’s ‘On the Waterfront.’ Her performance as Edie Doyle earned her the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress. She was just two days away from giving birth to her first child when she received the Oscar. While accepting the award, Saint joked, “I may have the baby right here!” She went on to appear in several films, including That Certain Feeling, A Hatful of Rain, Raintree County, Exodus, All Fall Down, 36 Hours, Grand Prix, The Russians Are Coming, The Stalking Moon and Cancel My Reservation.
However, one of her most remembered roles came in Alfred Hitchcock’s 1959 thriller North by Northwest. Saint played Eve Kendall opposite Cary Grant in the film, which became one of the most popular movies of her career.Saint also had a long career on television and continued working across different formats over the years. She married Jeffrey Hayden in 1951 after the two met on a subway. Hayden directed several popular television shows, including Leave It to Beaver and The Incredible Hulk. The couple later appeared together in a San Francisco production of A.R. Gurney’s Love Letters in 2011. (ANI)

items.title: Student protests erupt across Indonesia over rising living costs, forest fires
items.summary: Student protests erupted across Indonesia over rising living costs, economic concerns and forest fires, with demonstrators criticising President Prabowo Subianto's policies on the second anniversary ...
items.body:
Student protests erupt across Indonesia over rising living costs, forest fires Student protests erupted across Indonesia over rising living costs, economic concerns and forest fires, with demonstrators criticising President Prabowo Subianto's policies on the second anniversary of his administration, The Jakarta Post reported.
ANI | Updated: 21-10-2026 09:40 IST | Created: 21-10-2026 09:40 IST

Demonstrators protest against the government's handling of wildfires and demand an end to corruption, collusion and nepotism, in Jakarta (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Student protests erupted across Indonesia over rising living costs, economic concerns and forest fires, with demonstrators criticising President Prabowo Subianto's policies on the second anniversary of his administration, The Jakarta Post reported. Demonstrations took place in Jakarta, Yogyakarta and Bandung in West Java on Tuesday, as students and civil society groups voiced concerns over economic pressures, environmental damage and civil liberties.
In Jakarta, hundreds of university students gathered around the Tugu Tani monument, demanding action on rising living costs and the government's handling of forest and peatland fires. The fires have generated toxic haze, disrupted flights, forced school closures and raised public health concerns. Protesters called on the government to declare the prolonged forest fires a national disaster, prosecute companies responsible for environmental damage, tackle corruption and make education and healthcare more affordable. They also demanded stronger protection for freedom of expression.
According to RT, protesters in Indonesia also set a police truck on fire amid the unrest. Indonesia has struggled to contain forest fires in Sumatra, Kalimantan and Papua amid an unusually severe El Niño-driven dry season. The resulting haze has spread to neighbouring Singapore and Malaysia, prompting concerns over regional air quality and public health, The Jakarta Post reported.
Amid the protests, Presidential Chief of Staff General Police Listyo Sigit Prabowo said President Prabowo Subianto chaired a limited meeting at Merdeka Palace in Jakarta on Monday to discuss accelerating efforts to tackle forest and land fires. In a post on X, Listyo said the President had instructed authorities to strengthen aerial operations and improve coordination among the Indonesian National Armed Forces, National Police, National Disaster Management Agency, local governments and communities.
The President also called for investigations into 98 corporate cases suspected of being linked to forest and land fires to be expedited, Listyo said, adding that the Presidential Chief of Staff's office would oversee the government's response and ensure law enforcement proceedings were based on evidence and conducted in accordance with applicable regulations. Separately, Greenpeace Indonesia activists climbed the Welcome Monument at Jakarta's Hotel Indonesia traffic circle on Tuesday and unfurled large banners protesting what they described as the government's failure to address persistent wildfires, The Jakarta Post reported. (ANI)

items.title: "I want it to work out": Prince Harry says he wants to "reconcile" with King Charles, Prince William
items.summary: According to PEOPLE, the Duke of Sussex spoke about his relationship with his father and elder brother in a new interview with GQ magazine. During the conversation with GQ’s Zach Baron, Harry admitted ...
items.body:
"I want it to work out": Prince Harry says he wants to "reconcile" with King Charles, Prince William According to PEOPLE, the Duke of Sussex spoke about his relationship with his father and elder brother in a new interview with GQ magazine. During the conversation with GQ’s Zach Baron, Harry admitted that the family situation was something he continued to grieve.
ANI | Updated: 21-10-2026 09:36 IST | Created: 21-10-2026 09:36 IST

Prince Harry (Source: Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Prince Harry recently shared that he wants to resolve his family rift with King Charles and Prince William, saying that reconciliation is the most important thing amid everything happening in the world. According to PEOPLE, the Duke of Sussex spoke about his relationship with his father and elder brother in a new interview with GQ magazine. During the conversation with GQ’s Zach Baron, Harry admitted that the family situation was something he continued to grieve.
When asked about his “complicated relationship” with his father and brother, Harry acknowledged that family disputes were something many people could relate to. He also spoke about his wish to repair the strained relationships. “That continues to come up with me the whole time by people that I speak to. So I know how relatable it is,” Harry said, as per PEOPLE. He added that he understood why people were interested in his family situation and hoped his experience could help others dealing with similar problems.
“And some people don’t want it to work out. I want it to work out,” he added. Following the interview, a spokesperson for Harry clarified that his comment about some people not wanting things to work out was not directed at Prince William or any other member of the royal family.
Harry further spoke about the importance of making peace with family members, saying that he wanted to move past the differences. “With everything else that’s going on in the world, the most important thing is to reconcile. That’s the key point,” he said.
When asked whether the family rift could be repaired, Harry replied, “Yeah, of course.” He also spoke about how people could deal with painful experiences from the past. While acknowledging that emotional scars could remain, he encouraged people to change their outlook and try to move forward.
“Look, scars stick around forever, but what your perception is and what your mindset is to those things that have happened, certainly letting go of the past, that’s something that I would encourage everybody to do,” he said. Harry added that family disputes should not continue to take up space in people’s lives when there was already enough trouble in the world.
According to PEOPLE magazine, Harry and his wife, Meghan Markle, stepped back from their roles as working members of the British royal family in 2020. Their decision brought greater public attention to the family’s strained relationships. The couple later spoke about their experiences in their 2021 interview with Oprah Winfrey, their 2022 Netflix docuseries and Harry’s 2023 memoir. King Charles and Harry reunited over the summer. The meeting also marked Charles’ first time seeing Meghan and the couple’s children, Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet, in four years.
However, Harry and William have reportedly not been in direct contact. Royal author Russell Myers recently told PEOPLE that William’s position on his relationship with his younger brother remained unchanged. According to Myers, William believes his father’s relationship with Harry and the Sussex family is a matter for Charles to decide. He added that William does not see himself having a relationship with the Sussexes, either privately or in an official capacity, in the future. (ANI)

items.body:
"Hormuz is closed until America accepts our conditions": Araghchi demands US to honour MoU commitments "What we want from the American side is adherence to all the commitments contained in the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding that was signed earlier," Araghchi said. "After they adhere to these commitments, we can enter into negotiations on other cases."
ANI | Updated: 21-10-2026 09:35 IST | Created: 21-10-2026 09:35 IST

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

Country:

Iran

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has declared that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed to maritime traffic until the United States accepts Tehran's terms and fulfils its existing diplomatic commitments. Speaking in an interview with Iraq's Al-Ikhbariya network, relayed by state broadcaster IRIB, Araghchi emphasised that Washington must first adhere to the terms of the previously signed Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding before any broader negotiations can take place.
"Our position on the Strait of Hormuz is clear and unambiguous; we have previously announced and emphasised it," Araghchi stated. "The American side must accept our conditions to open the strait to ships and vessels. Before such an understanding or agreement is reached, the strait will naturally be closed, and the movement of ships and vessels through the strait and existing routes will face problems." Araghchi made it clear that Tehran will not enter into fresh negotiations on other issues until Washington honours its earlier promises.
"What we want from the American side is adherence to all the commitments contained in the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding that was signed earlier," Araghchi said. "After they adhere to these commitments, we can enter into negotiations on other cases." Addressing ongoing diplomatic channels, Araghchi revealed that indirect communications with Washington are continuing through regional intermediaries, including Pakistan and Qatar. He referenced a proposal previously submitted by Iran known as the "Seven-Day Plan".
"Our negotiations with the American side through intermediary countries, including Pakistan and Qatar, are continuing continuously," he noted. "We previously presented an initiative to the American side called the Seven-Day Plan, in which we clearly stated our conditions." According to Araghchi, the proposal outlined a timeline for reopening the vital waterway. "The Strait of Hormuz was supposed to be fully opened on the sixth day of this period," he said, adding that while Washington signaled agreement, it sought to introduce additional clauses on topics already addressed in prior talks.
Araghchi noted that "in the final stage of negotiations, any issue or problem raised by either party can be discussed and a final agreement can be reached". Rejecting American economic and military pressure, Araghchi affirmed that Washington's efforts to isolate Iran or force its surrender through coercion or regional pressure will fail.
"We have entered a deep quagmire, and therefore we are witnessing military threats, the imposition of economic sanctions, and the imposition of new sanctions," Araghchi said. He added that US attempts to pressure neighbouring states against cooperating with Iran have not received a positive response. "The American side should know that these measures will not work," Araghchi warned. "Iran will not surrender in any way, neither to economic sanctions nor to military threats. The only appropriate solution is diplomacy and a negotiated solution."
Clarifying Iran's position on the legal framework governing the waterway, Araghchi underscored that the Strait of Hormuz lies entirely within territorial waters. "The Strait of Hormuz is located in the internal waters of Iran and Oman and has no connection with international waters," Araghchi stated. "If the Strait of Hormuz were to open one day, the route that Iran and Oman have agreed upon would be the actual and agreed-upon route for ships to pass through; not another route."
He added that Iran and Oman have already reached an agreement regarding shipping lanes in the strait and are currently awaiting its international registration. Araghchi's remarks come amid continuing tensions between Tehran and Washington, with both sides exchanging accusations over the conflict and the prospects for diplomatic engagement. (ANI)

5:43 配信

米テキサス州ミッドランド郊外で稼働する石油ポンプジャック。2025年6月撮影。REUTERS/Eli Hartman

Georgina McCartney

[ヒューストン　２０日　ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は、取引時間中に５カ月ぶりの高値を付けた後、反落して取引を終えた。イランのペゼシュキアン大統領とパキスタン軍トップのムニール陸軍元帥のテヘランでの会談や、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派のサウジアラビアのインフラに対する攻撃継続、湾岸での船舶攻撃の報道など材料が交錯した。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が０．７６ドル（０．６９％）安の１バレル＝１０８．７９ドル。取引時間中に一時、期近物が１１１．９９ドルと、５カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。

米ＷＴＩ先物１１月限は１．８７ドル（１．８％）安の１０１．７９ドル。一時、１１０．４８ドルの高値を付け、期近物として４月以来の高水準となった。より取引が活発な１２月限は０．７２ドル安の９７．８２ドル。 

ペゼシュキアン大統領は２０日、首都テヘランを訪問したムニール陸軍元帥と会談した。イランのヌールニュースによると、両氏は仲介の取り組みや地域情勢について協議した。

こうした中、フーシ派は１９日、サウジアラビアのエネルギー関連施設や空港、軍事施設を標的とした複数の攻撃を実施したと表明。サウジ西部の紅海沿岸都市ヤンブーにある国有石油企業サウジアラムコの施設、シャイバ油田、首都リヤドのキング・ハーリド国際空港、アブハ空港を攻撃したとした。

ＩＮＧのアナリストは２０日付のリポートで「原油価格は引き続き底堅く推移している。これは、情勢の不安定さを踏まえ、市場が大きなリスクプレミアムを織り込んでいることを示唆する」と述べた。

Oct 20 : Super Micro Computer expects quarterly revenue and profit margin well above Wall Street estimates as it benefits from relentless AI data center demand, the server maker said on Tuesday, sending shares 11.3 per cent higher in after-hours trading.
Rivals Dell and HPE gained between 3.5 per cent and 4.9 per cent. Nvidia, the AI chip giant, was up 1.5 per cent.
Big Tech's race to build out data centers has placed firms such as Super Micro among the biggest beneficiaries of the AI boom. Microsoft, Google, Amazon and Meta are expected to spend more than $700 billion on AI infrastructure this year.
That is showing up in Super Micro's results.

FORECAST FOLLOWS AI SELLOFF
Shares of companies exposed to the AI data-center buildout fell last week after CoreWeave’s stock and bond slide and prospects of higher interest rates triggered concerns that heavily indebted operators could take longer than expected to generate returns.
S&P Global said on Monday it estimates the world's biggest tech firms are likely to have more AI-linked liabilities than known.
Super Micro on Tuesday said it expects revenue between $18.5 billion and $19.5 billion in the first quarter, compared with analysts’ average estimate of $15.23 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. That expectation is also well above the company’s prior revenue forecast of $14.5 billion to $15.5 billion.
The server maker also now expects gross margins to be in the range of 12 per cent to 12.5 per cent versus the prior expectation of 10.4 per cent to 10.8 per cent, and above analysts' estimate of 10.15 per cent, primarily due to customer and product mix.
Super Micro last week appointed former Western Digital executive Mark Long as its chief financial officer, nearly two years after beginning its search amid scrutiny of its financial and accounting practices.

items.title: スペースＸ、第3四半期161％増収　テスラとの合併「良い案」とマスク氏
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Akash Sriram

[２０日　ロイター] - 米実業家イーロン・マスク氏は２０日、自身が率いる宇宙開発企業スペー...
items.body:
スペースＸ、第3四半期161％増収　テスラとの合併「良い案」とマスク氏
5:23 配信

６月１１日撮影　REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Akash Sriram

[２０日　ロイター] - 米実業家イーロン・マスク氏は２０日、自身が率いる宇宙開発企業スペースＸと電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラの合併は「良い案だ」と述べ、両社が合併を協議する特別委員会を設置したことを明らかにした。スペースＸの株価は時間外取引で８％上昇した。

スペースＸはこれに先立ち、上場後初の黒字決算を発表。マスク氏は、人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームでデータセンター容量への需要が急増する中、２０２７年末までに年間経常収益が５０００億─１兆ドルに達するとの見通しを示した。

マスク氏は以前から、スペースＸとテスラの事業の重なりが拡大しているとして、合併の構想を示し、株主の関心を集めてきた。最近はスペースＸによるテスラ買収を巡る観測が強まっており、バークレイズは先週、１２月のテスラ年次株主総会前に合意が発表される可能性があるとの見方を示した。

マスク氏は投資家向け電話会議で「良い考えだと思うが、実際には両社の特別委員会次第だ」と述べ、正式に協議していることを初めて公式に認めた。「私は利益相反のある当事者なので、特別委員会の協議には実際には参加できない」と説明。最終的には株主の承認が必要になると述べた。

さらに「われわれは超知能によるシンギュラリティー（技術的特異点）にほぼ到達しており、両社の統合には大きな利点があると思う」とし、超知能ソフトウエアの開発、半導体設計、半導体合弁事業テラファブ、ロボット工学、スターマインド衛星群の構築に向けた軌道への輸送能力、通信接続の分野で協力することで、多くを得られると語った。

テラファブについては、２７年５─６月ごろに最初の試作半導体を製造する見通しで、２８年第３・四半期までの量産開始を目指すと述べた。

一方、特別委員会は取引条件で合意しておらず、今後も合意に至らない可能性があるとして、合併が実現すると考えるのは時期尚早だと指摘した。テスラ株は時間外取引で１．８％上昇した。

この日発表したスペースＸの第３・四半期決算は、売上高が前年同期比１６１％増の１４５億８０００万ドルとなり、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想の１２７億２０００万ドルを上回った。ＡＩ事業の売上高は約１０倍の７５億６０００万ドルに拡大した。その大半は独自のＡＩモデルではなく、アンソロピック、アルファベット傘下のグーグル、リフレクションＡＩといった開発企業へのデータセンター処理能力の貸し出しで稼いだ。

マスク氏は電話会議で「スペースＸは打ち上げ、通信、超知能の各分野で転換点を迎えている」と述べた。用意した説明の締めくくりに、原稿になかったとみられる発言として「要するに、これが意味するのは、２７年末までにスペースＸの年間経常収益が５０００億─１兆ドルになるということだ」と語った。

第３・四半期決算は、ＡＩ分野へのスペースＸの巨額投資が売り上げに結びついていることを、これまでで最も明確に示した。一方、計算処理インフラへの支出は依然として膨大で、設備投資額は約３倍の１９６億ドルに膨らんだ。

＜ＡＩ売上高が急拡大＞

スペースＸのブレット・ジョンセン最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は、２６年末までに年間経常収益が約１０００億ドルに達するとの見通しを改めて示した。

同氏は、第４・四半期の設備投資額を３５０億─４００億ドルと見込んでいると述べた。第３・四半期の設備投資額１９６億ドルのうち、ＡＩ事業が１６４億ドルを占めた。

資産運用会社グラナイトシェアーズのウィル・リンド最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は「スペースＸは、少なくとも売上高では強気派が望んだ四半期決算を示した」と指摘。「今や焦点は全てＡＩだ。２６年に入って締結された計算処理能力の提供契約が、多くの人が考えていたより速く売り上げにつながっている」と述べた。

スペースＸのＡＩ事業は「Ｇｒｏｋ（グロック）」、交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）のＸ、急成長するデータセンター事業で構成される。

ＡＩ部門はこれまで多額の営業赤字を計上しており、スペースＸは安定的に利益を生み出せるようになるまで継続的な投資が必要になると注意を促していた。ただ、第３・四半期は前年同期の赤字から黒字に転換した。

テクノロジー調査会社フューチャラム・グループのダニエル・ニューマン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は「ＡＩが売上高で同社最大の事業となる中、ハイパースケール事業が急速に営業面での強さとレバレッジを提供しており、衛星・打ち上げ事業の進展にもつながるだろう。スペースＸの事業基盤の強化と多角化が進むにつれ、テスラとの合併が間近に迫っているように感じられる」と述べた。

第３・四半期の純損益は４４億ドルの黒字となり、前年同期の１１億ドルの赤字から黒字に転換。市場予想の１５億７０００万ドルの黒字も上回った。ＩＢＥＳの計算による調整後１株利益は０．４５ドルで、予想平均の０．１３ドルを上回った。

＜スターリンク加入者数が予想上回る＞

衛星インターネット部門は、追加の衛星打ち上げや、個人、企業、航空、海運、政府向けサービスの拡充を背景に、加入者基盤の拡大を続けている。

スターリンクの第３・四半期の加入者数は１３６０万人と、アナリスト予想の１２１９万人を上回った。ただ、成長には代償も伴っている。海外で低価格プランを展開する中、加入者１人当たりの月間平均売上高は２３年の９９ドルから第３・四半期には６９ドルに低下した。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Lisa Richwine

[ロサンゼルス　２０日　ロイター] - 米動画配信サービス大手ネットフリックスが２０日公表...
items.body:
米ネトフリ、第4四半期利益見通しが市場予想下回る　時間外で株価5％超安
5:19 配信

米ネットフリックスのロゴ。2024年2月、インド・ムンバイで開催されたイベントで撮影。REUTERS/Francis Mascarenhas

Lisa Richwine

[ロサンゼルス　２０日　ロイター] - 米動画配信サービス大手ネットフリックスが２０日公表した第４・四半期（１０─１２月）の利益見通しは市場予想を下回った。２０２６年通期の広告収入見通しも引き下げた。

株価は時間外取引で６％近く下落し、６４．６６ドルとなった。この１年では４０％超下げている。

テッド・サランドス共同最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は決算発表後のビデオ会議で、ネットフリックスを欠かせないサービスにするため、質の高いテレビ番組や映画を制作する中核事業に注力する方針だと説明。最近の幹部人事刷新は、その目標に向けた一歩だとし、「われわれには改善の余地があると認識している。今、作品のラインアップを一段と充実させる機会が見えてきた」と語った。

第４・四半期の純利益見通しは２７億９０００万ドル、１株当たり利益（ＥＰＳ）見通しは０．６７ドルと、アナリスト予想平均の３０億７０００万ドル、０．７３ドルをそれぞれ下回った。

併せて発表した第３・四半期の売上高は１１．８％増の１２８億７０００万ドルと市場予想と一致したものの、伸び率は約３年ぶりの低水準となった。一方、１株利益は０．８７ドルと、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の０．８２ドルを上回った。

２６年の広告収入見通しは約３０億ドルから約２７億ドルに引き下げた。経営陣は四半期の株主向け書簡で、広告商品の一部機能の導入が想定よりやや遅れたと説明した。

約２０年前にテレビ番組や映画の配信を始め、ハリウッドに変革をもたらした同社は現在、視聴が急増するユーチューブやＴｉｋＴｏｋ（ティックトック）との競争に直面。こうした中、新たな視聴者を獲得し、会員の利用時間を伸ばすため、ビデオゲームやポッドキャスト、ライブイベントに投資してきた。

ウォール街のアナリストからは、同社がどのように成長を再加速させるのか疑問の声が上がっている。

ＰＰフォーサイトのアナリスト、パオロ・ペスカトーレ氏は「ネットフリックスは引き続き効率的に運営され、高い収益力を持つ企業だが、本来不要な取り組みに手を広げすぎている」と指摘。「基本に立ち返り、魅力的なコンテンツに注力する必要がある」と述べた。

ネットフリックスは決算発表で、外部コンテンツのライセンス取得を増やし、配信作品を引き続き拡充する方針を示した。その上で、経営陣は株主向け書簡で、テレビ番組、映画、ライブイベントの配信という中核サービスに注力し、「話題を呼び、会員を増やし、われわれを『欠かせない』サービスにする」オリジナル番組に投資すると説明した。

同社は先週、全従業員の６％に相当する約１０００人を削減すると発表した。また、チーフクリエーティブオフィサー（ＣＣＯ）のベラ・バジャリア氏を交代させ、映画部門責任者のダン・リン氏も退任すると明らかにし、番組編成戦略を立て直す姿勢を示した。

ネットフリックスは今年、ワーナー・ブラザース・ディスカバリーの買収競争に敗れた。一部のアナリストは、ネットフリックスが他の買収対象に目を向ける可能性があるとみており、コムキャストが分離した後のＮＢＣユニバーサルなどを候補に挙げている。

調査会社アンテナのデータによると、ネットフリックスの米国契約者数は２６年に入り９月まで毎月純減となっている。

items.title: 米国株式市場＝ダウ主導で上昇、ヘルスケア株に買い　ナスダック横ばい
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Tharuniyaa Lakshmi

［ニューヨーク　２０日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場はダウ工業株３０種が１％上昇...
items.body:
米国株式市場＝ダウ主導で上昇、ヘルスケア株に買い　ナスダック横ばい
5:12 配信

2026年6月23日、米国カリフォルニア州サンディエゴで撮影　REUTERS/Mike Blake

Tharuniyaa Lakshmi

［ニューヨーク　２０日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場はダウ工業株３０種が１％上昇し、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種を上回る値上がりとなった。ヘルスケア株が相場を最も押し上げた一方、前日に反発したハイテク株は軟調だった。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の主要１１業種では、ヘルスケア株指数が上昇率首位となり、過去最高値を更新した。イーライリリーがＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種への押し上げ寄与度で首位となった。ユナイテッドヘルス、メルク、ジョンソン・エンド・ジョンソン（Ｊ＆Ｊ）、アムジェンはダウの上昇に寄与した。

超大型株の下落で通信サービス指数は値下がりした。原油価格が一時５カ月ぶりの高値を付けた後に下落したことを受け、エネルギー指数もさえない値動きとなった。原油市場では、イランのペゼシュキアン大統領とパキスタン軍トップのムニール陸軍元帥のテヘランでの会談や、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派のサウジアラビアのインフラに対する攻撃継続、湾岸での船舶攻撃の報道など材料が交錯した。

情報技術指数の下落率は０．３％にとどまったが、構成比率が大きいため、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種への最大の圧迫要因となり、ナスダック総合もほぼ横ばいに抑えられた。ハイテク株は先週、人工知能（ＡＩ）開発を巡る巨額の支出や資金調達コストへの懸念から売られたが、１９日には反発していた。

プラント・モラン・ファイナンシャル・アドバイザーズのジム・ベアード最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）は、この日の小型株やヘルスケアなどの上昇に言及し、「株式投資家はＡＩ関連投資や、一部企業が投資を収益化できるかどうかについて、依然としてやや懐疑的だ。そのため、市場の他の分野に資金が移る動きが見られる」と指摘。「投資家はハイテク以外の投資機会を探しており、ヘルスケアはその恩恵を受ける分野の一つだ」と語った。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００バリュー指数は０．９％上昇した一方、グロース指数は０．２％下落した。小型株で構成するラッセル２０００指数は１．７％高で取引を終えた。

金融指数は１％上昇。ディフェンシブ業種も堅調で、不動産は１．７％、公益事業は１．２％上昇した。

ネットフリックスは１．７％、メタ・プラットフォームズは１．６％、グーグルの親会社アルファベットは１％それぞれ下落し、通信サービス指数は０．９％安となった。

スペースＸは取引終了後に発表した第３・四半期利益が市場予想を大幅に上回り、時間外取引で株価が４％上昇した。

ネットフリックスは取引終了後に発表した第４・四半期の利益見通しが市場予想を下回り、株価は６％下落した。

メタとテスラは２１日に決算発表を予定している。

ゼネラル・モーターズ（ＧＭ）は６．８％急落。コモディティー（商品）価格の上昇とトラック販売の減少が今後数カ月の業績を圧迫するとの見通しを示した。

複合企業のスリーエム（３Ｍ）は５．８％上昇した。アマゾン・ドット・コムとのデータセンター事業での提携拡大を発表し、アマゾン子会社に対し、５億２１００万ドル超相当の３Ｍ普通株を購入できる新株予約権を発行した。通期利益見通しも引き上げた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では、値上がり銘柄数と値下がり銘柄数の比率が２．０４対１だった。ナスダックでも２．０２対１で値上がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は１５９億１０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７１億５０００万株。

items.title: Musk says SpaceX-Tesla merger is 'a good idea' as companies form deal committees
items.author: Akash Sriram, Joey Roulette
items.creator: Akash Sriram, Joey Roulette
items.summary: Musk has in the past tantalized shareholders with the idea of combining SpaceX and Tesla, citing growing overlap between them. Speculation about a union has gained traction recently.
items.body:
Elon Musk said on Tuesday that a merger of his two companies SpaceX (SPCX.O) and Tesla (TSLA.O) would be "a good idea" and that they had formed special committees to discuss a union, sending shares of the space and technology company up 8% in extended trading.
The company earlier posted its first profit as a public company and Musk said he expected annual recurring revenue of between $500 billion and $1 trillion by the end of 2027, as demand for its data-center space surges thanks to the AI boom.
Musk has in the past tantalized shareholders with the idea of combining SpaceX and Tesla, [USN:L6N43O1D8 TEXT:"citing growing overlap"] between them. Speculation about the space company buying the EV maker has [USN:L6N46612X TEXT:"gained traction"] recently, with Barclays suggesting last week that a deal could be announced before Tesla's annual meeting in December.
"I think it would be a good idea, but it's really up to the special committees of both companies," Musk said in the first official confirmation that the companies were formally talking. "Because I'm a conflicted party, I can't actually be in the discussions of the special committees," which comprised independent directors, he told investors on a conference call.
The companies had formed the special committees at the request of shareholders, who ultimately would need to approve a deal, he added.
"I do think there's a lot of merit to combining the companies as we are pretty much in the superintelligence singularity, and there's a lot to be gained from cooperating on developing superintelligence software, chip design, the Terafab obviously, robotics, mass-to-orbit with the Starmind constellation, connectivity," he said.
Terafab, the chip manufacturing joint venture between the two companies, should produce its [USN:L6N4661EP TEXT:"first test chip"] around May or June of next year and aims to reach volume production by the third quarter of 2028, Musk said on the call.
Musk added that it would be premature to assume a SpaceX-Tesla merger would happen, noting that the special committees had not agreed on transaction terms and may never do so. Tesla shares rose 1.8% in extended trading.
The world's richest person, Musk owns nearly a fifth of Tesla and just under half of SpaceX, and analysts have said a merger would give him control of the combined entity.
The talks started in recent weeks and could result in SpaceX acquiring Tesla, a person familiar with the matter told Reuters, who declined to be named because they were not authorized to talk to media. Tesla has been working with an investment bank to advise on the discussions, the person said.
AI REVENUE DRIVES SPACEX TRANSFORMATION SpaceX's revenue climbed 161% to $14.58 billion for the three months ended September 30 from a year earlier. AI revenue surged by almost 10 times to $7.56 billion, mostly from renting out data-center capacity to developers such as Anthropic, Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Google and Reflection AI rather than from its own models.
The third quarter offered the clearest evidence yet that SpaceX’s heavy investment in AI is translating into revenue, even as spending on compute infrastructure remains enormous — capital expenses nearly tripled to $19.6 billion.
The shift is reshaping a company whose financial engine has long been its Starlink internet services business and whose longer-term ambitions still hinge on getting Starship rockets into regular service. For now, though, its main business looks closer to a cloud provider's than an AI lab's.
SpaceX's chief financial officer, Bret Johnsen, said the company expects $35 billion to $40 billion in capital expenditure in the fourth quarter.
"SpaceX delivered the quarter the bulls wanted, at least on the top line," said Will Rhind, CEO of asset manager GraniteShares. "The story now is all about AI. The compute contracts signed earlier this year are turning into revenue faster than a lot of people thought."
The company's AI business spans Grok, social media platform X and a fast-growing data-center operation. The business also turned a profit in the third quarter, compared with a year-ago loss.
SpaceX reported net income of $4.4 billion versus a net loss of $1.1 billion a year earlier and analysts' expectation for a profit of $1.57 billion. On a per-share, adjusted basis, it earned 45 cents according to IBES calculations, outstripping a 13-cent average estimate.
STARLINK SUBSCRIBERS TOP FORECASTS The satellite-internet unit has continued to expand its subscriber base, aided by additional satellite launches and a growing range of consumer, enterprise, aviation, maritime and government services.
Starlink reached 13.6 million subscribers in the third quarter, above the 12.19 million analysts expected, but growth is coming at a price: average monthly revenue per subscriber has fallen from $99 in 2023 to $69 in the third quarter as it expands abroad with cheaper plans.
The company has said geographic expansion beyond the wealthiest countries could push average revenue per user lower over time.
Starship, SpaceX's next-generation reusable rocket system, has yet to enter commercial service. It is expected to enable deployment of higher-bandwidth Starlink satellites and orbital AI-computing infrastructure. The company's ability to turn Starship into a reliably reusable vehicle is central to its longer-term strategy.
The space segment includes commercial launches, government missions and Starship development and remains a significant source of costs and uncertainty.

items.title: Netflix co-CEO Sarandos says 'we could do better' after weak forecast
items.author: Lisa Richwine, Jaspreet Singh
items.creator: Lisa Richwine, Jaspreet Singh
items.summary: Days earlier the streaming pioneer laid off 6% of its workforce and replaced two of its top programming executives.
items.body:
Netflix (NFLX.O) issued weaker-than-expected guidance for fourth-quarter profit and cut its full-year advertising forecast on Tuesday, days after the streaming pioneer laid off 6% of its workforce and replaced two of its top programming executives.
Shares of Netflix fell nearly 6% to $64.66 in after-hours trading. The stock had fallen more than 40% in a year before the earnings report.
Co-CEO Ted Sarandos said the company plans to focus on its core business of producing quality TV shows and movies to make Netflix a must-have service, and the recent executive shakeup was a step toward that goal.
"I know that we could do better," Sarandos said in a post-earnings video call. "Now we've seen an opportunity to take our slate to the next level."
Third-quarter revenue rose 11.8% to $12.87 billion, in line with Wall Street forecasts, but the lowest rate of increase in nearly three years. The company forecast fourth-quarter net income of $2.79 billion and EPS of 67 cents, below the average analyst forecast of $3.07 billion and 73 cents.
Netflix reduced its advertising forecast for 2026 to roughly $2.7 billion, down from about $3 billion. Some ad product capabilities rolled out slightly slower than expected, executives said in their quarterly letter to shareholders.
The company that shook up Hollywood when it started streaming TV shows and movies two decades ago is now competing with a surge in viewership on YouTube and TikTok. Netflix has invested in video games, podcasts and live events to draw new viewers and increase the time members spend on the platform.
Wall Street analysts have questioned how the company will kick-start growth.
"Netflix remains a well-oiled, highly profitable machine, but focused on too many unwanted distractions," PP Foresight analyst Paolo Pescatore said. "The company needs to get back to basics and focus on compelling content."
In its earnings report, Netflix said it would continue to expand its offerings through licensing more third-party content.
For the third quarter, earnings per share came in at 87 cents, ahead of the 82-cent average forecast of analysts surveyed by LSEG. New programming during the quarter included "Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story," the second season of "The Gentlemen," the final installment of "Outer Banks" and a reboot of "Little House on the Prairie."
Last week, Netflix [USN:L6N4600X7 TEXT:"laid off 1,000 people"], or about 6% of its employees. The company replaced Chief Creative Officer Bela [USN:L4N46128P TEXT:"Bajaria"] and said film chief [USN:L4N4651E5 TEXT:"Dan Lin was departing"], signs that it is resetting its programming strategy.
The company named former Disney and Fox executive Peter Rice to replace Bajaria. He also will oversee the film division until a replacement for Lin is chosen.
"Peter Rice understands talent relations, and in a competitive market, creative talent have choices of where they want to work," Sarandos said on Tuesday. "We want Netflix to always be the place that they love to do the best work of their life."
Earlier this year, Netflix lost a bidding war for Warner Bros Discovery and its rich library of characters, which was sold to David Ellison-led Skydance . Some analysts believe Netflix could go after other acquisition targets such as NBCUniversal after Comcast (CMCSA.O) spins it off.
Netflix has posted monthly subscriber losses in the US throughout 2026, with no net additions reported for any month up to September, data from analytics firm Antenna showed.
Antenna tracks US subscription purchases via sources like credit card transactions, but excludes subscriptions acquired through wholesale bundles. A Netflix spokesperson said the Antenna data were "not representative of Netflix's business performance."
Sarandos said there was no need for a "fundamental shift" in strategy but added: "We do need better execution in the US."

items.summary: Ukraine uses Starlink for battlefield communications and drone operations. Restricting the satellite service hampered the country's attack and air defence drone missions against Russia ...
items.body:
Home / World News / Musk ordered slowdown of Starlink service used by Ukraine's military

Musk ordered slowdown of Starlink service used by Ukraine's military Ukraine uses Starlink for battlefield communications and drone operations. Restricting the satellite service hampered the country's attack and air defence drone missions against Russia

Musk and US President Donald Trump discussed the Starlink decision in a call soon after the slowdown became public (Photo: Reuters)

Reuters 2 min read Last Updated : Oct 21 2026 | 8:21 AM IST

Listen to This Article

Elon Musk last week ordered the slowdown of a military-grade version of SpaceX's Starlink satellite service that Ukraine relies on, the Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday, citing US officials and people familiar with the matter.
  Musk, SpaceX and the White House did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment. Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
  Ukraine uses Starlink for battlefield communications and drone operations. Restricting the satellite service hampered the country's attack and air defence drone missions against Russia.
  Musk and US President Donald Trump discussed the Starlink decision in a call soon after the slowdown became public, while the president was campaigning last week, according to the report, which added the two had also discussed the matter prior to the decision to throttle Starlink.
 

  Reuters had reported exclusively that the order to limit the satellite system came from inside the White House.

Diesel deal aimed to keep peace talks with Russia going, says Trump

  Trump said last week he did not think either he or Musk was responsible for Ukraine losing Starlink access, while Musk said any limits on speed or Starship use were decided by the US military or the president.
  Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskky's relations with Washington have sunk to new lows after Trump announced a deal to buy Russian diesel and waived new sanctions on Moscow. Trump has also told Kyiv to stop attacking Russian refineries and urged Ukrainians to replace Zelenskky.
  Zelenskky, who is in Oslo in a bid to repair US relations, said on Tuesday he discussed issues including "the situation with Starlink/Starshield, which needs to be restored" with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio.

  US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth said on Tuesday Washington had not pulled back Ukraine's ability to access Starling's satellite network, but signaled the problem lay with the terms of service Kyiv needed to comply with. 

(Only the headline and picture of this report may have been reworked by the Business Standard staff; the rest of the content is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

items.body:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル下落、ＡＩ懸念が重し　円は20年債入札好調で上昇
4:48 配信

３月２４日撮影　REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

［ニューヨーク　２０日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対し下落した。ドルは原油価格と米長期債利回りの低下に歩調を合わせるように下落。市場では、米国とイランの対立激化による影響のほか、米国のＡＩ（人工知能）関連企業に対する旺盛な資本流入が持続可能性が注目されている。

終盤の取引で、円は対ドルで０．２１％高の１５８．１４円。日本の財務省が実施した２０年利付国債入札で応札倍率が５．８４倍と、前回（４．０１倍）から大幅に上昇し、同入札としては過去最高を付けたことが円の支援材料になった。

ステート・ストリート・インベストメント・マネジメントのシニア債券ストラテジスト、マサヒコ・ルー氏は「２０年債入札に対する記録的な需要は、待機資金がついに市場に戻り始めたことを示す強いシグナルになる」と指摘。「フランスの政治・財政面での不透明感を背景に、資金の安全な逃避先として日本国債の魅力が相対的に高まりつつある」と述べた。

主要６通貨に対するドル指数は０．２５％安１０１．７１。ユーロは対ドルで０．２２％高の１．１２３５ドル。

この日は原油価格が一時５カ月ぶりの高値を付けた後、下落。ただ、市場ではＡＩを巡る懸念がより大きく意識されている。野村証券のＧ１０通貨戦略責任者、ドミニク・バニング氏は、「エネルギー価格の上昇はドル相場にとって追い風になるが、金利がＡＩ関連取引を崩壊させるほど高い水準に達すれば、ドル相場にとってマイナスの影響を及ぼすことになる」と指摘。「現在はまさにその境目となる水準が試されているところだ」としている。

ユーロはこの日の取引では対ドルで上昇したものの、市場ではフランスの財政状況の悪化や各地で広がる抗議活動への警戒感から、ユーロに対する慎重な見方が根強い。スウェーデンのハンデルスバンケンの外国為替ストラテジスト、トミー・フォンブロムセン氏は「フランスを巡る懸念はすぐには解消されない」と指摘。「フランスに対する弱気な見方は当面続くと見られるため、ユーロには一段の下落余地がある」と述べた。

カナダドルは対米ドルで０．３４％高の１．４０６カナダドルと、約１カ月ぶりの高水準を付けた。 カナダ西部アルバータ州で１９日に実施された分離独立を問う住民投票でカナダへの残留が支持され、国内の結束を図るカーニー首相にとって待望の勝利となった。

items.title: Anthropic logged net loss of over $80 billion in first half of 2026
items.author: Echo Wang
items.creator: Echo Wang
items.summary: Anthropic's net loss widened sharply to $80.7 billion in the first half of this year, in large part due to a rise in the fair value of bonds convertible into shares of the AI startup, according to a draft prospectus for a planned initial public offering that was reviewed by Reuters.
items.body:
Anthropic's net loss widened sharply to $80.7 billion in the first half of this year, in large part due to a rise in the fair value of bonds convertible into shares of the AI startup, according to a draft prospectus for a planned initial public offering that was reviewed by Reuters.
The San Francisco-based company is expected to go public in November and some investors are now weighing a lower valuation of around $1.5 trillion following its latest financial disclosures, Reuters [USN:L6N46118I TEXT:"reported"] last week.
Its first-half loss, widening from a loss of $13 billion a year earlier, included a $72 billion accounting charge reflecting an increase in the estimated value of bonds that could eventually convert into Anthropic shares, rather than cash costs tied to its operations, the document said.
The disclosures underscore the hefty costs of the AI race even as investors give greater scrutiny to whether the vast sums being poured into chips and data centers will generate sufficient returns.
Anthropic has committed to spending at least $518 billion over a decade on cloud services, computing and infrastructure.
The company spent nearly $9 billion on computing capacity and infrastructure in the first half, up from $2.3 billion a year earlier, the S-1 document showed.
Anthropic did not respond to a Reuters request for comment.
FINANCING COSTS At an investor meeting on October 14, Anthropic told prospective IPO investors that its third-quarter revenue jumped 45% to $16.8 billion from the previous quarter, Reuters reported, citing people familiar with the matter.
While the figures eased some concerns about the enormous costs of developing AI systems, some investors were disappointed by the slowing sequential growth rate. Revenue had more than doubled from the first quarter to $11.6 billion in the second quarter.
A cooler reception for Anthropic's IPO could weigh on the wider AI market, whose near-term prospects investors see as hinging largely on the share sale's success, ahead of rival OpenAI's potential listing next year.
Reuters reported in September that Anthropic posted a net loss of [USN:L4N4500J8 TEXT:"$42 billion in 2025"], with most of that stemming from a similar accounting charge. As Anthropic's valuation climbed, the estimated fair value of those notes tripled year over year.
Excluding the charge, Anthropic posted an operating loss of about $8.1 billion on $4.6 billion of revenue in 2025.
The company has benefited from the popularity of Claude Code, its coding assistant that developers use to write software and build apps.

items.body:
欧州市場サマリー（20日）
4:18 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞ 

続落して取引を終えた。銀行株や資源関連株が売られ、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は小幅に続落。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．０６％安だった。

英労働市場統計によると、賃金上昇ペースはわずかに加速し、雇用に回復の兆しが見られた。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、市場ではイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）が１１月に０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決めることがほぼ確実視されている。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種銀行株指数は０．８４％安。金融大手ＨＳＢＣ、ナットウエスト、ロイズは０．９─１．１％下落した。

資源株指数は１．５９％下落。石油大手のＢＰは１．７％、シェルは０．８％それぞれ下落した。

一方、公益事業株指数は１．５２％高。電力・ガス供給のナショナル・グリッドは１．８％上昇した。住宅建設株指数は３．２９％高。

ＪＰモルガンが目標株価を引き上げたオンラインスーパー大手オカドは１０．０％上昇した。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞ 

続落して取引を終えた。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連投資への懸念などから、工業株の売り注文が優勢だった。フランスのＣＡＣ４０指数は０．３８％安と続落。経済の停滞や財政悪化といった課題を抱えるフランスで、激しい抗議デモが発生。約半年後に大統領選を控えることもあり、投資家の警戒感が強まっている。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種工業株指数は１．４３％安。データセンター関連を顧客とするスイス重電大手ＡＢＢは５．０％安。機関投資家から資金調達を実施した配電・制御機器大手シュナイダー・エレクトリックは３．３％下落。

一方、フランスのクラウド事業者のＯＶＨクラウドは１８．０％高。財務指標が改善し、買われた。直近の四半期決算が増収だった電子機器メーカーのコメット・ホールディングは４．７％上昇した。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、市場では、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が今月の理事会で金利を据え置いた後、１２月会合で利上げを決めることが有力視されている。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　

フランス国債利回りが２４年ぶりの高水準近辺で推移した。抗議デモの拡大懸念を背景に前日は約1カ月ぶりの大幅上昇を記録し、この日も荒い値動きが続いた。終盤には小幅低下した。

フランス１０年国債（ＯＡＴ）利回りは終盤に３ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の４．８８％。一時４．９８７７％まで上昇し、２００２年７月以来の高水準となった１０月初旬の４．９９３７％に迫った。

独仏１０年債利回り格差は約２．５ｂｐ拡大し、１５０ｂｐとなった。この利回り格差は１０月初旬に１５８．６７ｂｐと、２０１１年１１月以来の水準に拡大していた。

ゴールドマン・サックスのストラテジストらは「直接的な経済への影響は当面限定的にとどまるとみているが、混乱がさらに広がる可能性は、金融環境の引き締まり、政治的不確実性の高まり、緊縮財政によって既に弱まっている経済に、新たな逆風をもたらす」と指摘した。

一方、ユーロ圏の指標となるドイツ国債の利回りは低下したものの、最近のレンジ内にとどまった。エネルギー価格の上昇圧力が根強く、投資家は欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の追加利上げ観測を後退させていない。

ドイツ１０年国債利回りは７ｂｐ低下の３．３８５％。

政策金利見通しに敏感なドイツ２年国債利回りは５ｂｐ低下し、３．０４５％となった。

独伊１０年債利回り格差は１．５７ｂｐ縮小し、１０９．５ｂｐとなった。

ユーロ圏金融・債券市場：[DE/BJ]

items.title: 英中銀グリーン委員、利上げ主張　「インフレ加速リスク想定以上」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ロンドン ２０日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（ＢＯＥ、英中央銀行）のグリーン金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）委員は２０日...
items.body:
英中銀グリーン委員、利上げ主張　「インフレ加速リスク想定以上」
3:23 配信

英ロンドンのイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）前で９月撮影。REUTERS/Corey Rudy

[ロンドン ２０日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（ＢＯＥ、英中央銀行）のグリーン金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）委員は２０日、イラン戦争に伴うエネルギー価格ショックから広範なインフレが加速するリスクは、英中銀の予想を上回っていると述べ、利上げが必要だとの見解を改めて示した。

グリーン氏は利上げに賛成票を投じてきたＭＰＣ内の少数派の一員。エネルギーショックによるいわゆる「二次的波及効果」がより強いと想定して行動し、必要に応じて後から政策を調整する方が望ましいと指摘した。

ロンドン・スクール・オブ・エコノミクス（ＬＳＥ）で講演し「したがって、私は引き続き『二次的波及効果』のリスクに対して先手を打って対処すべきだと考えている」と述べた。

英中銀はこれまでのところ、イラン戦争を受けて利上げに踏み切った米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）や欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）に追随していない。

ただ、利上げ見送りを支持してきたベイリー総裁は、先週のバンコクでの講演で、紛争が長引けば長引くほど英中銀が対応しないでいることは難しくなるとの見方を示している。もっとも、インフレ圧力は「かなり抑制されている」との認識も示した。

市場では、英中銀が１１月に政策金利を０．２５％ポイント引き上げ、４％にすると予想されている。

グリーン氏は講演で、賃金の伸びは公式統計が示唆するよりも高いとの認識を示した。２０２７年初めに予定される賃金改定は、その時点でインフレ率が４％前後となる可能性が高いことを踏まえると、想定を上回る水準となる可能性があるとの見方を示した。

さらに、エネルギー価格の急騰にもかかわらず英経済が今年に入って底堅さを示していることも、利上げを支持する根拠になると述べた。

items.title: Nigeria confirms Ebola case in patient who arrived from Uganda
items.author: Elisha Bala-Gbogbo, Camillus Eboh
items.creator: Elisha Bala-Gbogbo, Camillus Eboh
items.summary: Nigeria's government said on Tuesday there was a case of Ebola in the capital, Abuja, after laboratory tests confirmed the viral infection.
items.body:
Nigeria's government said on Tuesday there was a case of Ebola in the capital, Abuja, after laboratory tests confirmed the viral infection.
Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate told the public broadcaster that the female patient had travelled from Uganda in East Africa.
"She is in isolation, and she is receiving quality medical care. Contact tracing has been conducted, and it's under way as we speak, with 44 contacts already identified," Pate told public broadcaster NTA.
Uganda's Health Ministry said in a public statement late on Tuesday that the patient had travelled to eastern Democratic Republic of Congo for business and transited Uganda in early October without symptoms before developing symptoms after arriving in Nigeria.
"Travel through Uganda does not establish that infection occurred here. The location of exposure remains under investigation," the ministry said, adding that Uganda had "no confirmed active Ebola cases" at the time of the statement.
Pate said in a statement that the patient had been admitted to a private hospital in Abuja, where she had received care for several days before the diagnosis was confirmed.
"Nigeria successfully contained Ebola in 2014, and we have the experience and public health systems to respond to this case," the minister said in the statement.
An Ebola outbreak was declared in Democratic Republic of Congo in mid-May and has since grown into the world's [USN:L8N45Z1AX TEXT:"second-largest"] outbreak ever, caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain.
Uganda reported 20 cases in May and June, mostly imported from Congo, but was [USN:L6N44N0VL TEXT:"declared free"] of the virus by the World Health Organization in August.
Kenya has reported [USN:L1N4660OP TEXT:"nine Ebola cases"] this month, all linked to a person who had travelled from Congo.
Africa's top public health agency has started mobilising support for Nigeria, said its head, Jean Kaseya.
"This Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has already become the most geographically extensive in history, affecting ... countries spread across three regions of Africa," Kaseya said in a post on X.

items.title: Phoenix Tailings to build $375M rare earth plant in New York
items.author: Marina Meireles
items.creator: Marina Meireles
items.summary: The facility will produce over 4,400 tons of annual rare earths oxides by 2028 and will create at least 90 new jobs in the region.
items.body:
Phoenix Tailings to build $375M rare earth plant in New York 

Marina Meireles | October 20, 2026 | 9:56 am
Critical Minerals   Intelligence   China   USA   Rare Earth   Rare Earths  

( Image: Phoenix Tailings. )

Phoenix Tailings announced Tuesday it will build a $375-million commercial-scale rare earths processing facility in Rochester, New York, as the US looks to loosen China’s grip on minerals. 

The plant, called Freedom Separation, will process more than 18,000 tons of both mined and recycled rare earth feedstock annually, producing over 4,400 tons per year of separated rare earth oxides at its full capacity. Production is expected to ramp up in 2027 before reaching full capacity in 2028. 

“Technology can give America control over its critical supply chains, but it takes skilled, determined people to turn that promise into production,” Phoenix Tailings CEO and co-founder Nick Myers said in a statement . “Rochester has those people. They know how to build, how to innovate, and how to run world-class industrial operations.”  

Phoenix Tailings selected Eastman Business Park in the city of Rochester for the 500,000-square-foot facility, citing its existing industrial infrastructure and local expertise in engineering, manufacturing, chemical processing and operations.  

New York governor Kathy Hochul said the state will provide $3 million in performance-based tax credits for the project, Reuters reported.  

“I am committed to supporting innovative projects and companies that are ready to invest in New York and bring good-paying jobs,” Hochul said. “Phoenix Tailings will not only create at least 90 new jobs at Eastman Business Park, further supporting our state’s innovation economy, but they will also play a critical role in bolstering our national security by building a supply chain for rare earth elements in New York.” 

Federal backing   

The Rochester facility forms part of Phoenix Tailings’ $1.2 billion Freedom project, a separation and metallization platform designed to close the gap in US midstream rare earth processing capacity. 

The broader initiative is slated to generate more than 500 jobs across New York, Massachusetts and New Hampshire. 

The Freedom Project has secured a $500-million conditional loan commitment from the Department of War’s Office of Strategic Capital. Phoenix’s new facility is also backed by democratic NY state governor and US Senator Chuck Schumer. 

Rare earth refiner gets $500M loan from Pentagon to build ‘Freedom Facility’  

“This is critical for reducing our reliance on foreign processors and protecting our national security,” Schumer said. “I’ve long championed Eastman Business Park as a hub for manufacturing and am glad that new companies are recognizing what I have long known: Upstate New York is a prime destination for new manufacturing investments.” 

(With files from Reuters)

items.title: Iran tells Pakistan army chief no talks with Washington until demands are met
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: President Masoud Pezeshkian discussed mediation efforts and regional developments with Field Marshal Asim Munir in Tehran.
items.body:
Iran told Pakistan's army chief on Tuesday that there would be no talks with Washington until Tehran's demands were met, Iranian media reported, underscoring its hardening stance despite mediation efforts by key interlocutor Pakistan.
President Masoud Pezeshkian discussed mediation efforts and regional developments with Field Marshal Asim Munir in Tehran, according to Nournews.
Pakistan is a key intermediary between the United States and Iran. Earlier mediation efforts helped produce an [USN:L1N42P0Q6 TEXT:"interim peace agreement"] in June, but the Islamabad Memorandum quickly unravelled as fighting between Iran and the US resumed weeks after.
Munir also met Iranian parliament speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, who said Washington could not regain Tehran's trust until it fulfilled [USN:S8N43Z003 TEXT:"seven conditions"] Iran set last month for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, according to an Iranian readout of the meeting.
The demands include ending a US blockade on its ports, the lifting of sanctions on its oil exports as well as ending hostilities on all regional fronts.
Iran's security chief, Mohsen Rezaei, delivered a similar message during a separate meeting with Munir, saying there would be [USN:L8N46515R TEXT:"no talks"] with Washington until Tehran's demands were met, according to Iranian media.
Rezaei also said all enriched nuclear materials would remain in Iran, reiterating Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei's [USN:L8N41X1O4 TEXT:"position"] that near-weapons-grade uranium should not be shipped abroad.
US Vice President JD Vance said [USN:L6N45S099 TEXT:"earlier this month"] that Iran must make a "meaningful" reduction in its uranium enrichment capacity to satisfy US demands and end the countries' eight-month-old war.
Israel, the United States and other Western states have long accused Iran of seeking nuclear weapons, including pointing to its move to enrich uranium to 60%, far higher than needed for civilian uses and closer to the 90% needed for a weapon.
Iran denies seeking nuclear weapons.

items.title: Blackstone, Warburg explore IntraFi sale at over $10 billion, sources say
items.author: Echo Wang, Milana Vinn
items.creator: Echo Wang, Milana Vinn
items.summary: Blackstone Inc and Warburg Pincus are exploring a sale of IntraFi that could value the financial technology company at more than $10 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.
items.body:
Blackstone Inc (BX.N) and Warburg Pincus are exploring a sale of IntraFi that could value the financial technology company at more than $10 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.
The private equity firms have hired Morgan Stanley (MS.N) and Guggenheim Securities to advise IntraFi on the sale process, which is in its early stages, said the people, who requested anonymity speaking about matters that are not public.
No final decision has been made and Blackstone and Warburg could opt to hold onto the business, the people added.
Blackstone and [USN:L6N3XG0WX TEXT:"IntraFi"] declined to comment. Guggenheim, Morgan Stanley and Warburg Pincus did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
Arlington, Virginia-based IntraFi operates what it describes as the largest reciprocal deposit network in the United States, helping banks spread customers' money across multiple banks to provide federal deposit insurance on balances exceeding $250,000.
The company's network also allows banks to buy and sell deposits. Banks with excess deposits can sell them to banks that need funding, with IntraFi earning fees from the transactions.
[USN:L6N45916U TEXT:"The failure of Silicon Valley Bank"] in 2023 made customers more selective about where they kept their money, intensifying competition among banks for deposits.
Founded in 2002 by three former bank regulators, IntraFi was acquired by Blackstone in 2019 from a group of backers that included Bank of New York Mellon (BNY.N) , when the company was known as Promontory Interfinancial Network. Warburg Pincus invested in the business in 2022. IntraFi generates $630 million in annual EBITDA, the sources said.
The sale process comes as private equity firms seek to capitalize on improving dealmaking conditions. Warburg Pincus recently agreed to sell McGill and Partners and [USN:L6N41E0OQ TEXT:"WildFire Energy"], while [USN:L4N45S0CQ TEXT:"Blackstone this month"] agreed to sell Clarion Events to Informa for about 2.2 billion pounds.
The two firms previously explored a sale of IntraFi, Bloomberg News reported in 2024.

items.title: NATO to send planes and drones to Black Sea after attacks on shipping
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: NATO has not attributed the recent spate of attacks to any country. Military analysts have said Russia almost certainly carried out the attacks.
items.body:
NATO will send more maritime patrol aircraft, radar systems and drones to the Black Sea, the military alliance said on Tuesday, after a [USN:S8N3YR019 TEXT:"series of deadly drone attacks"] on shipping in the region apparently linked to Russia's war in Ukraine.
The announcement came after NATO's main decision-making body, the North Atlantic Council, discussed security in the Black Sea at the alliance's Brussels headquarters.
In addition to the aircraft, drones and radar systems, NATO members have sent or will send intelligence agents and teams to conduct forensic analysis of explosives, said U.S. Army Colonel Martin Martin L. O'Donnell, a NATO military spokesperson.
NATO has not attributed the recent spate of attacks to any country. Military analysts have said Russia almost certainly carried out the attacks but Moscow has not acknowledged responsibility for them.
Last week, seven sailors were reported missing after drones struck two chemical tankers near Romania's Black Sea coast, setting them ablaze and raising fresh security concerns along a vital shipping route used by Ukraine.
At least five other cargo vessels were hit near the coasts of Romania and neighbouring NATO member Bulgaria over the previous 10 days, with at least 23 sailors reported missing or dead.
"NATO has already strengthened our posture along the eastern flank, including with counter-drone capabilities," Allison Hart, NATO's principal spokesperson, said in a post on X.
"We will continue to stand united and ensure that we are ready and able to address any threat and to keep our one billion people safe."

Musk is on a donation spree—SpaceX shares for US kids to $276 million for Republican groups

Musk’s political donations are far higher than those of most individual donors. His plan to give every child in America a SpaceX share could be worth an estimated $10.5 billion.

Sakshi Mehra

20 October, 2026 07:58 pm IST

New Delhi: Elon Musk is in a giving mood. Over the past few days, he has announced a plan to give a SpaceX share to every child in America. Meanwhile, newly disclosed filings show he has donated more than $276 million to Republican political groups since July, making him the biggest known donor of the 2026 midterm election cycle.

Musk’s political donations are far higher than those of most individual donors. His plan to give every child in America a SpaceX share could be worth an estimated $10.5 billion. 

However, not all the money he has announced has been given. Some are pledges, some are prize money, while others have gone to organisations closely linked to his businesses.

Show Full Article

SpaceX share for every American child

Musk said on 19 October that he would give one of his SpaceX shares to every kid in America next year, calling it “the first of many.”  The plan would cover about 72 million children and is estimated to be worth $10.5 billion, based on SpaceX’s reported share price. 

$158 million to Senate Republicans

Musk donated $158 million to the Senate Leadership Fund, the main Republican super PAC focused on Senate elections. Much of the money was directed toward supporting Texas Republican Ken Paxton’s Senate campaign. 

More than $76 million to America PAC

Musk also gave more than $76 million to America PAC, the political committee he founded in 2024. The PAC is running voter-turnout operations in competitive Senate and House races. As its founder and biggest financial supporter, Musk plays a major role in funding its political activities.

$20 million to House Republicans

Musk donated $20 million to the Congressional Leadership Fund, the leading super PAC supporting Republican candidates for the House of Representatives. The money will support Republican efforts to defend their majority in the House during the midterm elections.

$10 million to Ken Paxton’s Texas campaign

Musk gave $10 million to the Lone Star Liberty PAC, which supports Paxton’s campaign for the US Senate in Texas. Musk lives near SpaceX’s Starbase facility in South Texas, adding a personal and business connection to his political spending in the state.

$10 million to Republican governors

Musk donated $10 million to the Republican Governors Association, which supports Republican candidates running for governor across the US. 

$2 million to Republican attorneys general

Musk gave $2 million to the Republican Attorneys General Association, which supports Republican candidates for state attorney general offices. These officials can play an important role in legal challenges to federal policies, making the association another part of Musk’s political giving.

$500,000 to Greg Abbott

Earlier in 2026, Musk donated $500,000 to Texans for Governor Greg Abbott, according to Texas campaign-finance filings. The contribution was made during the first six months of the year and adds to his financial support for Republican politicians in Texas.

(Edited by Aamaan Alam Khan)

items.title: Fed sneezes, but emerging markets aren't catching a cold yet
items.author: Jamie McGeever
items.creator: Jamie McGeever
items.summary: Emerging markets have developed stronger immune systems. US debt dynamics are deteriorating and the Federal Reserve has started hiking interest rates, yet EM appears under no pressure to follow suit. The US has sneezed, but EM isn't catching the proverbial cold.
items.body:
Emerging markets have developed stronger immune systems. US debt dynamics are deteriorating and the Federal Reserve has started [USN:L4N3XG141 TEXT:"hiking interest rates"], yet EM appears under no pressure to follow suit. The US has sneezed, but EM isn't catching the proverbial cold.
Historically, when the Fed starts tightening policy, emerging economies are forced to hike as well, even if their domestic economies aren’t strong enough to warrant it, due to currency concerns and debt dynamics. This has given rise to another market cliche: the Fed is central banker to the world.
But surprisingly resilient economic growth across emerging economies this year, sturdier fiscal fundamentals, and relatively high interest rates and bond yields are offering EM central banks a degree of flexibility. That could allow them to start cutting rates in the next year, or, at the very least, enable them not to follow the Fed in lockstep as it tightens.
RATE BUFFER Emerging markets – like their developed peers – are currently beset by a host of risks stemming from geopolitical strife, trade frictions, the energy price shock, and AI bubble fears. But even though some EM countries are particularly vulnerable, either to persistently high energy prices or a sudden, disorderly unwind of the AI trade, the threat of rapidly tightening monetary policy is mostly absent.
This is largely because policy rates are already elevated across much of EM. The weighted average 10-year emerging bond yield at the end of September was around its highest point in five years at nearly 6.45%, according to State Street. Average inflation-adjusted EM yields, meanwhile, are also historically high, close to 3%.
Lofty policy rates have helped restore EM central bank credibility, support exchange rates, and create a real rate buffer. Bank of America strategists say EM rates at the front end of the curve have "materially" overshot to such an extent that implied policy rates next year will be in restrictive territory in all major emerging economies except China.
"Widespread tightening seems unlikely," State Street strategists wrote earlier this month.
While EMs look surprisingly calm, robust, and attractive – with some notable exceptions like [USN:L4N466046 TEXT:"Indonesia "]– the same cannot be said of their developed-market peers.
While many emerging countries appear to be strengthening their economic fundamentals, investors’ concern over the fiscal trajectory in the [USN:L6N45O0TM TEXT:"US"], [USN:SPN45900X TEXT:"Japan"], much of the [USN:L6N4660NP TEXT:"euro zone"], and the UK has sent yields across the industrialized world to the highest in decades.
PIQUE INTEREST Investors are positioning accordingly. A JPMorgan survey of investors at the International Monetary Fund/World Bank meetings in Bangkok last week showed that 33% favor EM stocks, compared with 26% who prefer developed market equities. Bank of America's latest fund manager survey shows that a net 34% of those polled are overweight in EM stocks, down slightly from 38% in September, but hardly bearish.
Could investors be too optimistic about EM? Perhaps. The long EM equities position is one of the most crowded trades in BofA's survey, suggesting there is still plenty of room for it to be trimmed further.
Of course, EM bond yields are higher because EM debt is still a riskier proposition than developed market offerings, especially traditionally "risk-free" US Treasuries. But it is notable that realized volatility in EM bonds has been lower than that of Treasuries for a few years, according to iShares benchmark EM bond (EMB.O) and Treasuries ETFs (TLT.O) .
To be sure, emerging economies' debt burden is rising, narrowing the gap with highly indebted advanced economies. But the average EM debt-to-GDP ratio still appears manageable. The IMF projects an overall EM debt-to-GDP ratio this year of 77.2%, rising to 86.2% in five years, compared with forecasts for advanced economies of 108.2% this year, rising to 114.8%.
While the debt-to-GDP risk threshold in EM countries is lower because these economies are typically less resilient, few alarm bells are being rung. Indeed, the rise in EM debt has been quite gradual, suggesting policymakers are determined to keep it under control.
NOT A MONOLITH Rising Fed rates and US market turbulence will always affect EM economies, especially those carrying more dollar-denominated debt. And there will always be idiosyncratic EM distress stories, like we’re currently seeing in Indonesia. But events like this typically bear little relation to the broader emerging market narrative. Removing Indonesia could actually make EM equity indices more attractive to investors.
It’s also important to remember that the EM universe is wide, and the differences between economies are vast. Policymakers in some EM countries where core inflation is relatively low and expectations are anchored, like Brazil and Mexico, are cutting rates, and some, like South Africa and South Korea, are raising them to offset currency weakness or inflation. Others may prefer to keep their options open.
But the Fed doesn't appear to be calling the EM tune like it used to, and if the record attendance at Barclays' EM Conference in Bangkok last week is any guide, that's music to investors' ears.
(The opinions expressed here are those of the author, a columnist for Reuters)

items.author: Jonathan Levin
items.creator: Jonathan Levin
items.summary: Corporate credit, monetary policy’s sleeping giant, is finally stirring. Cloud computing service provider CoreWeave Inc.’s bonds dropped this month, sending yields on its 2032 notes as high as 15%. Yields for junk and investment-grade debt reached the highest since 2025 and 2023, respectively. The implication is that the cost of corporate credit, a key channel through which central banks tap the economy’s brakes to cool inflation, may start to weigh on growth.
